defects.proposedCure: `error` is not a variant of *empty*, it is a status on the *field*. Give it two shapes: cold-load failure → plate replacement (keep); refresh failure → a persistent status strip ABOVE the retained field, owning the retry. The tri-state then reduces to `field | field+status | empty-invitation` and the seven divergent guards collapse to one owner.

defects.defect: In dark mode the aria-hidden ornament is the highest-luminance ink on the plate — the decoration outranks both the statement and the label.
defects.evidence: Measured OKLab L on /#/admin/tags dark: ghost trio stroke = `--accent-live` dark = oklch(95.832172477266% …) → L 95.83%; headline `--foreground` = rgb(233,230,226) → L 92.62%; eyebrow/hint `--ink-muted` dark = oklch(88.996429564553% …) → L 89.00%. On a dark plate higher L = more contrast, so the hierarchy runs decoration (+3.22 L pts over the headline) > statement > label. Frames: probes/emptystate-dark-admintags.png and visual/shots/safari-mobile-dark/admin-tags.png — the white dashed blob is louder than the "Tags" identity line.
defects.mechanism: tier inversion — an ornamental token was allowed to outrank content tokens because no scheme-aware rank law binds decoration below ink
defects.reproduction: Playwright context `colorScheme: "dark"` → http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags; read `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--accent-live")`.
defects.proposedCure: Absence is neutral. Retint the mark to the neutral de-emphasis rung and reserve `--accent-live` for the add-slot ghost, where a live-colour preview is data rather than ornament.

defects.defect: The `plate-ink` de-emphasis rung is 6.4x weaker in dark than in light; three of the plate's four text lines lose their rank entirely in dark mode.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:102-104 binds eyebrow, hint and error detail to `--ink-muted`. Measured: light `--foreground` L 21.61% vs `--ink-muted` L 44.71% = +23.10 L pts; dark `--foreground` L 92.62% vs `--ink-muted` L 89.00% = −3.62 L pts. Asymmetry 6.38x. The component's own comments (:49-54, :95-101) record that D6's floor-clamp cured a 3.84:1 light-mode contrast failure.
defects.mechanism: a contrast floor was substituted for a hierarchy law — clamping the dark rung up to satisfy 4.5:1 pushed it to within 3.6 L points of the foreground
defects.reproduction: Read `--ink-muted` and `--foreground` from documentElement under each colorScheme on http://localhost:9000/#/palettes; convert to OKLab L.
defects.proposedCure: Express de-emphasis as a *relation* (a fixed ΔL or contrast ratio against the local plate) rather than a per-scheme absolute rung, so the floor-clamp raises legibility without collapsing rank.

defects.defect: The mark is fed an ink-contrast-guarded token into a specimen slot; the component's stated premise ("ghosts reading the LIVE accent") is false in dark mode, where chroma collapses 8.95x.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:45-47 passes `color="var(--accent-live)"`. demo/styles/foundation.css:220-231 defines that token as ink: "`--accent-live` is the contrast-guarded LIVE picked color … guarded to the light-scheme lightness so first paint is never ink." Measured, same hue 9.834deg: light oklch(47.118925176164% 0.188447570516) vs dark oklch(95.832172477266% 0.021053120065) — chroma 0.1884 → 0.0211, 8.95x collapse. EmptyState.vue:6 states the premise. Law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:17 assigns the Watercolor tier "the only ornamental COLOR-BEARING species". No unguarded source is wired: `--ground-seed`, `--atom-1`, `--atom-2` all resolve to "" and `data-ground-state` is null on the live tree.
defects.mechanism: wrong token class — an ink-legibility projection consumed where a specimen/chromatic projection was intended, with no unguarded channel in existence
defects.reproduction: Read `--accent-live` from documentElement under colorScheme light then dark on http://localhost:9000/#/palettes.
defects.proposedCure: Stop claiming the mark reads the user's colour. A ghost depicting *absence* should be neutral; the live colour belongs to the add-slot ghost, which genuinely previews the next swatch.

defects.defect: The three-dot Watercolor mark ships unconditionally on all five Admin routes, where the canon authorises no such mark; the `dots` escape hatch has zero consumers across 16 call sites.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn ":dots|dots=" --include=*.vue demo/` → no output. `dots` defaults true at EmptyState.vue:90; its own doc (:83-88) requires shedding it in a case that is never exercised. Laws: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:186 scopes `EmptyPaletteMark` to the palette-library/Browse empty invitation; :218 (Admin) authorises none ("Elevated authority is communicated by labeling and scope, not by a fourth visual system"); :17 restricts the Watercolor tier to swatches / active mark / pastel `Palettes` identity. Frame: visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/admin-tags.png shows TWO identical trios in one 1440x900 viewport plus a third dashed ghost in the "Start a new palette" slab. Live-measured instance counts: 2 on /#/admin/tags, 2 on /#/browse, 1 on /#/palettes.
defects.mechanism: a scoped species escaped its scope because suppression was a boolean default nobody passes rather than a separate import
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags at 1440x900 — `document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="empty-state-trio"]').length === 2`.
defects.proposedCure: Make the mark a separate glass-ui primitive that Admin simply does not import. Suppression by composition, not by a `:dots="false"` nobody remembers.

defects.defect: The canon's named primitive `EmptyPaletteMark` was never built; the mark is inlined as three raw producer calls with Tailwind size/opacity utilities written onto the glass-ui root.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "EmptyPaletteMark" --include=*.vue --include=*.ts demo/` → no output, yet the name is ratified at VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:186, archive/waves/W22.md:20 and reformation/waves/W49-W52.md:45. EmptyState.vue:45-47 instead writes `class="w-8 h-8 opacity-80"`, `class="w-11 h-11"`, `class="w-6 h-6 opacity-60"` onto `<WatercolorDot>`. Violates edict 5 (per-instance override of a producer root), edict 4 (mark species composed in demo/ not glass-ui) and edict 3 (the ratified primitive is the KISS answer).
defects.mechanism: design-system boundary breach — a producer species composed at the consumer, so it cannot be reused, suppressed, or governed independently of its host plate
defects.reproduction: Read EmptyState.vue:39-48 against VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:186.
defects.proposedCure: Build `EmptyPaletteMark` in glass-ui: one primitive, one authored size with internally-proportioned satellites, direction-invariant internals, a scale-invariant stroke, one `forced-color-adjust` decision, `aria-hidden` once. This single move also closes D-3, D-5, D-8, D-18, D-20 and answers N-6/N-7.

defects.defect: One flat `gap-2.5` serves four semantic ranks, so the rendered ink rhythm is ragged and there is no title-gap / section-gap distinction at all.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:16,28 apply `gap-2.5` (measured row-gap 10px) between every sibling. Measured line boxes: eyebrow 14.384/21.576, headline 25.888/35.596, hint 16.40/22.96 → half-leadings 3.596 / 4.854 / 3.280. Rendered ink gaps: mark→eyebrow 13.60px, eyebrow→headline 18.45px, headline→hint 18.13px. The decoration is bound 26% more tightly to the label than the label is to the statement, and the two most distinct joints get indistinguishable intervals. Law: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:68 §5.3 "Header→headline uses title gap; headline→next semantic section uses section gap"; :73 §5.8 "Real rendered relation wins over token intent."
defects.mechanism: a single spacing token applied across elements with different line-heights yields three different rendered intervals — flat authored rhythm, ragged rendered rhythm
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/palettes; measure the four children's getBoundingClientRect y/height and computed font-size/line-height.
defects.proposedCure: Two named gaps from the glass-ui ladder: title gap (label→statement) and section gap (statement→action), with half-leading compensated so the RENDERED ink intervals — not the box gaps — carry the rank.

defects.defect: Nothing about the plate is container-scaled, and the type pair's ratio drifts 19.5% across the viewport range because one arm is fluid and the other is frozen.
defects.evidence: Measured 1440px vs 320px on the same host: padding-block 32px → 32px (0%), row-gap 10px → 10px (0%), trio width 116px → 116px (0%), eyebrow font-size 14.384px → 12.032px (−16.4%, `text-mono-caption` is fluid), headline font-size 25.888px → 25.888px (0%, `text-heading` is fixed). Headline:eyebrow ratio 1.800 → 2.152 = +19.5% drift. At 320px the 116px mark occupies 45.7% of the 254px plate. Laws: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:33 §3.7 "Spacing is container-scaled from glass-ui tokens"; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:15 requires a paired clamp holding the ratio "through floor, fluid arm and ceiling rather than only at endpoints". Frame: probes/state-320-admintags.png.
defects.mechanism: mixed scaling law — fixed Tailwind rungs for space and ornament, a fluid token for one type arm and a fixed token for the other
defects.reproduction: Playwright viewport 320x900 → http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags; compare computed padding/gap/font-size against 1440x900.
defects.proposedCure: Container-scale padding and gap from the glass-ui ladder, and put the caption/headline on one paired clamp so the ratio is invariant across floor, fluid arm and ceiling.

defects.defect: The 26ch/36ch/44ch measures are font-relative across three families, so the authored ladder does not render — and the headline's measure is inert on every plate the component currently occupies.
defects.evidence: Measured resolved `max-inline-size`: headline (Fraunces 25.888px, `max-w-[26ch]`) = 469.474px; error detail (Fira 16.4px, `max-w-[44ch]`) = 444.062px; hint (Fira 16.4px, `max-w-[36ch]`) = 363.323px. Plate width is 462px on /#/palettes, /#/browse and all five admin plates — so the headline's 469.474px clamp NEVER engages, while the two support clamps do. Above a 469.5px container it silently switches on. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:218 mandates "Each Admin route uses the full main width", which would cross that threshold. Law: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:73 §5.8 "token presence alone cannot close a row."
defects.mechanism: `ch` is font-relative; mixing it across three families and sizes makes the authored numbers non-comparable and the display line's constraint accidentally inert
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/palettes; `getComputedStyle(headlineP).maxInlineSize` = "469.474px" while the plate rect width = 462px.
defects.proposedCure: Express all three measures in one shared measure token (or one font's ch), so the authored ladder is the rendered ladder and the crossover threshold is chosen rather than accidental.

defects.defect: Two same-species plates in one frame sit 78px out of vertical register, and the offset grows with zoom; the plate has no min-height and no relation to its sibling.
defects.evidence: Measured /#/admin/tags at 1440x900: Tags plate height 185.17px with mark top y 466.19; My Palettes plate height 218.14px with mark top y 544.06 — Δ height 32.97px, Δ mark top 77.87px. At 200% zoom: heights 370.3 / 482.1px, mark tops 156.7px apart (probes/state-zoom200-admintags.png). Height is purely a function of how many optional props the host passed. Law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:34 §3.8.
defects.mechanism: content-driven height with no shared register — the species has no min-block-size and no baseline contract with sibling instances
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags at 1440x900; compare the two `[data-slot="empty-state-trio"]` bounding rects.
defects.proposedCure: Give the species a min-block-size from the ladder so sibling plates in one frame share a register, and derive height from the mark+statement pair rather than from optional-prop count.

defects.defect: Two violations of the closed type matrix: Fraunces applied to the `text-heading` role, and help prose rendered in Fira Code.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:20,58 apply `font-display text-heading` → measured 25.888px / 35.596px / 700 / Fraunces. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:68-78 binds `text-heading` to "section heading → Plus Jakarta Sans" and declares the matrix closed with exactly one exception (P019's Picker pair); PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:78 §5.13 restates it. EmptyState.vue:61 renders `hint` as `text-mono-small` → measured 16.4px Fira Code, while the matrix binds "prose/help → text-prose → Plus Jakarta Sans" and reserves Fira for "value, code, or provenance". (The error `detail` in Fira is correct — that one IS machine truth.) Frame: visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/browse.png — "Add colors above, then save the set." reads as terminal output.
defects.mechanism: family override applied on top of a role token, creating a second unauthorised paired exception; and a help role mapped to the provenance family
defects.reproduction:
http://localhost:9000/#/palettes; read computed fontFamily/fontSize on the headline and hint

elements.
defects.proposedCure: Re-seat both on the closed matrix: Plus Jakarta Sans for the `text-heading` role and for help copy. If the plate genuinely needs a Fraunces display line, it should claim `text-display`/`--type-title`, not override `text-heading`'s family.

defects.defect: Two incompatible mark languages inside one component, and the failure mark is 8.9x smaller than the ornament for the non-event.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:19 draws a `@lucide/vue` `CircleAlert` — a 24x24px geometric 1.5px-stroke line glyph at oklab(0.574284 0.191676 0.099719 / 0.8). EmptyState.vue:45-47 draws seeded organic watercolour blobs under an SVG turbulence filter. No shared tier exists for both in VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:11-17. Ornament footprint 116x44 = 5104px² vs failure glyph 24x24 = 576px² → 8.9x. Frame: visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/browse.png shows both plates side by side.
defects.mechanism: mark-grammar collision — a generic icon-set glyph seated beside a bespoke drawn species, with the ranking inverted
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/browse (backend down) at 1440x900 — the error plate and the empty plate render in adjacent columns.
defects.proposedCure: One mark grammar per product. Either the failure gets a drawn mark in the same species, or the empty mark shrinks below the failure's rank — a failure must never be the quieter signal.

defects.defect: Unbreakable content in `message` is silently clipped at both edges with no scroll or ellipsis, and long `hint`/`detail` grow the plate without bound — while only one of four text arms carries `break-words`.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:20 (headline) has `max-w-[26ch] text-balance` and NO `break-words`; :23 (detail) HAS `break-words` — an inconsistency inside one component. Injecting a 63-char unbroken token into the live headline on /#/palettes: headline box 469.5px vs plate 462px → 3.7px clipped left AND right; host computed `overflow-x: hidden` with hostScrollWidth 510 === hostClientWidth 510 → no scroll produced (probes/state-unbreakable-token-clip.png). A ~100-char URL in the hint grew the plate 218.14px → 322.64px (+48%) with no clamp (probes/state-overflow-long-strings-1440.png). `detail` is an arbitrary-length server string inside an assertive role="alert" region.
defects.mechanism: per-arm wrapping decisions instead of one species-level overflow law; and no clamp on machine-supplied content
defects.reproduction:
http://localhost:9000/#/palettes → set the headline

's textContent to `Nosavedpalettesyetnorwillthereeverbeanyonthisparticularplateever` and measure its rect against the plate rect.
defects.proposedCure: `overflow-wrap: anywhere` on every text arm (not one of four), plus a line clamp with disclosure on `detail` so a stack trace neither blows the plate open nor is read out whole.

defects.defect: The mark mirrors under RTL — the asymmetric 32/44/24 composition flips, because it is built from flex children rather than one direction-invariant primitive.
defects.evidence: Measured with dir="rtl" on /#/admin/tags: dot x-positions 32px @ x=1011, 44px @ x=959, 24px @ x=927 — the 32px dot moves from leftmost to rightmost. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:150-154 §6.1 assigns inline mirroring to "chrome, navigation and layout"; a drawn ornamental mark is neither. Frame: probes/state-rtl-admintags.png.
defects.mechanism: a drawn mark expressed as inline flow inherits inline-direction mirroring it never asked for
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags → `document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir","rtl")` → read the three dots' getBoundingClientRect().x.
defects.proposedCure: Draw the mark as one primitive with direction-invariant internals (or a single SVG), which is exactly what the ratified `EmptyPaletteMark` would have provided.

defects.defect: The loading|error|empty|populated state machine has no owner, so it is re-wired across two shared components plus inline blocks in seven files, and each host re-decides the branch order.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:2-3 deliberately excludes loading. The machine is spread across demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue (error+empty), demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminListSkeleton.vue, demo/palettes/browser/card/PaletteCardSkeleton.vue, plus inline Skeleton blocks in BrowsePane.vue, AdminUsersPanel.vue, AdminTagsPanel.vue, AdminAuditPanel.vue, AdminNamesPanel.vue, AdminFlaggedPanel.vue and ExtractWorkbench.vue. The per-host branch-order freedom is the direct cause of D-2's policy split.
defects.mechanism: a fissioned module — a shared atom too small to own its own state machine, so 16 hosts each own a fragment
defects.reproduction: `grep -rln Skeleton --include=*.vue demo/palettes demo/workbenches` returns 9 files; compare the v-if/v-else-if ordering in AdminUsersPanel.vue:46-63 against BrowsePane.vue:43-78.
defects.proposedCure: One `<FieldState>` wrapper owning the four-state switch, its live region (bound to the field, so both directions announce) and its transition — with `FieldSkeleton`, `FieldFailure` and `EmptyInvitation` as its three arms.

defects.defect: Forced-colors mode strips the content colours but keeps the ornament's author colour, promoting the decoration to the only coloured ink on the plate.
defects.evidence: Under Playwright `forcedColors: "active"` on /#/admin/tags: text computed `color: rgb(0, 0, 0)` (forced) while the ghost keeps `background-color: color(srgb 0.79408 0.000149374 0.318273 / 0.12)` and its dashed accent stroke (not forced). Frames: probes/forced-colors-admintags.png and visual/shots/forced-colors-desktop/adminusers.png — the trio is the only colour left on an otherwise black-on-white plate. Law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:84 requires state distinctness "in both schemes, forced colors and reduced transparency".
defects.mechanism: no forced-colors design at the species level; the plate inherits whatever the producer leaks
defects.reproduction:
Playwright context `{ forcedColors: "active" }` → http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags; read computed color on the

s and backgroundColor on the `.watercolor-swatch` spans.
defects.proposedCure: Decide `forced-color-adjust` once, inside the `EmptyPaletteMark` primitive — an absence mark should resolve to a system boundary colour, not survive as the page's only chroma.

defects.defect: Motion belongs to the hosts rather than the species, so four of five Admin routes swap a 185–218px slab with a hard v-if pop while BrowsePane gets a spring.
defects.evidence: `grep -c Transition`: BrowsePane.vue 1 (`<Transition name="vj-morph" mode="out-in">` at :40), AdminUsersPanel.vue 3, MixSourceSelector.vue 4, AdminTagsPanel.vue 0, AdminAuditPanel.vue 0, AdminNamesPanel.vue 0, AdminFlaggedPanel.vue 0. EmptyState.vue declares no @keyframes, no transition, no `--animation-slide-*` and no prefers-reduced-motion branch. BrowsePane.vue:29-40 carries a comment insisting the swap must "SETTLE into the wall on the snappy spring instead of a hard v-if POP" — and only BrowsePane gets it. Law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:141 §6 "No full-slab remount hole." Edict 6.
defects.mechanism: motion authored per host instead of per species, so it exists at 3 of 16 addresses by accident of authorship
defects.reproduction: Compare demo/palettes/BrowsePane.vue:40 with demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminTagsPanel.vue:49-83 — the same species, one wrapped in a Transition and one not.
defects.proposedCure: The species owns its enter/exit — a tokenized glass-ui transition on the `<FieldState>` wrapper, with a `prefers-reduced-motion` branch resolving directly to final geometry. Hosts stop deciding.

defects.defect: The live-region design is asymmetric and reads the ornament aloud: role="status" is bound to the empty branch (so only one direction of the state change announces), and role="alert" wraps a focusable Retry button.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:28 sets role="status" (implicit aria-live=polite + aria-atomic=true) on the empty branch, so "became empty" announces and "results arrived" never does — the region unmounts. Measured accessible text: "· no tags minted ·No tags yet." (the eyebrow is not aria-hidden). EmptyState.vue:17 sets role="alert" (assertive) on a container whose #action slot holds a focusable <button>Retry</button> — measured on /#/browse: role=alert with children svg / p / p / button. Two role="status" regions coexist on /#/admin/tags. Law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:114 "changed result count/state through the OWNING status region".
defects.mechanism: the live region was attached to a state instead of to the field, and made atomic over decorative content
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags — `document.querySelectorAll('[role="status"]').length === 2`; textContent of each includes the `·` frame.
defects.proposedCure: Move the live region to the field wrapper so both empty→populated and populated→empty announce; aria-hide the ornamental eyebrow frame; make the failure region polite-with-focus-management rather than assertive-with-orphan-button.

defects.defect: The `· … ·` frame is presentation encoded in eleven content strings, and one call site restates the component's own default verbatim.
defects.evidence: Every empty call site hand-writes the bullets: "· empty plate ·", "· no tags minted ·", "· roster clear ·", "· ledger clear ·", "· queue clear ·", "· none approved yet ·", "· nothing flagged ·", "· none pinned ·", "· nothing to mix ·", "· the commons ·". demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue:78 passes `empty-eyebrow="· empty plate ·"` which is verbatim the default at EmptyState.vue:90. The bullets enter the accessible name (measured: "· no tags minted ·No tags yet.").
defects.mechanism: presentation leaked into content — the label species' frame is retyped by every consumer instead of drawn by the species
defects.reproduction: `for f in $(grep -rl "<EmptyState" --include=*.vue demo/); do perl -0777 -ne 'while(/<EmptyState\b(.*?)(?:\/>|>)/gs){print}' $f; done` — 11 of 16 sites carry a hand-typed `·` pair.
defects.proposedCure: The plate-label species draws its own frame from an aria-hidden pseudo-element; consumers pass only the phrase. A dropped bullet then cannot silently break the register, and AT stops hearing punctuation.

defects.defect: The mark is mechanically flex-centred but optically off-axis — its ink centroid sits 2.8px left of the copy axis.
defects.evidence: Measured trio container x=397 w=116 (centre 455), gap 8px, align-items flex-end. Dots: 32px@x=413 op 0.80, 44px@x=459 op 1.00, 24px@x=501 op 0.60. Weighting by outline perimeter x opacity: (25.6·413 + 44·459 + 14.4·501)/84 = 452.2px vs the text axis at 455.0px.
defects.mechanism: a drawn mark composed as three independently-sized flex children has no optical-centring control
defects.reproduction:
http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags — read the three dots' rects and the parent

's centre.
defects.proposedCure: Optical centring is a property the `EmptyPaletteMark` primitive should own once, alongside its internal proportions — it is unreachable while the mark is three utility-sized siblings.

defects.defect: The centred island introduces a second, unrelated horizontal axis 231px away from the panel's established reading axis.
defects.evidence: Measured on /#/admin/tags: plate copy axis x = 455; the panel's reading axis (pane header "Tags", "0 tags", the tag-name field) x = 224. No other centred text exists on the route. Law: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:5 "Every element earns its scale, interval, boundary and material from its job relative to the local protagonist."
defects.mechanism: `items-center justify-center text-center` chosen as a species default without regard to the host's alignment grammar
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags at 1440x900 — the EmptyState rect is x=224 w=462 while its text lines centre at 455.
defects.proposedCure: Let the invitation align to the host's reading axis by default and centre only where the host is itself a centred stage; alignment is a composition decision, not a species constant.

defects.defect: Non-idiomatic Vue 3.5: `withDefaults(defineProps<…>(), …)` rather than reactive props destructure with defaults.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:72-91. Edict 7 names reactive props destructure as the 3.5 idiom for custom components. verbatimModuleSyntax is satisfied — both imports at :69-70 are value imports and no type-only import is mis-declared. The six redundant `| undefined` unions on already-optional props are noise.
defects.mechanism: pre-3.5 props idiom retained
defects.reproduction: Read EmptyState.vue:68-92.
defects.proposedCure: `const { variant = "empty", eyebrow = "· empty plate ·", dots = true } = defineProps<…>()` — and drop the redundant `| undefined` unions.

defects.defect: One host of this species appears in none of the 60 real-Safari captures — a coverage hole for the visual matrix.
defects.evidence: MixSourceSelector.vue:239 renders the plate only in Palettes source mode, behind a tab. Live probe of /#/mix in both schemes returned 0 instances; the REPORT.md matrix therefore never photographs it.
defects.mechanism: tab-gated host not exercised by the capture script
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/mix — `document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="empty-state-trio"]').length === 0` on load.
defects.proposedCure: Add a Mix Palettes-mode step to visual/states.mjs so every host of a shared species is captured at least once.

result.axis: design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-system boundary, proportion/seat law) — component `demo/shared/ui/PaneHeader.vue`, the sole route-identity surface for 9 panes
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]`. Explicitly declared at spawn; served tier agrees. Not inherited, not undeclared.
result.strongestDefect: D-1/D-2 (one family): `--pane-title-shrink-ratio: calc(tan(atan2(var(--type-heading), var(--type-display-1))))` at PaneHeader.vue:140-142 resolves to a DIFFERENT, WRONG number in WebKit at both named bands. At 390px it resolves to 1.619766 where the file's own law (`:137-139`) demands exactly 1.0 — so on Safari phone the pane title GROWS 1.62x on scroll (ink 27.16 -> 43.99px) and overflows a 68.97px band, colliding with the collapse chevron. At 1440px it resolves to 0.310797 vs the law's 0.618 (Chromium: 0.618016) — the title collapses to 13.67px of ink, smaller than the body mono beneath it, inverting the pane's own hierarchy. defects.mechanism: CSS-arithmetic-as-design-law. WebKit degrades the <angle> returned by atan2() to a bare <number>, and tan() then correctly reads a bare number as radians: tan(atan2(1.618rem,1.618rem)) evaluates as tan(45 radians) = 1.6197751 instead of tan(45deg) = 1. Isolates prove it is argument-specific, not a blanket bug: tan(45deg)*1000px = 1000px and tan(atan2(1px,1px))*1000px = 1000px are both CORRECT in WebKit; only the rem/clamp arm fails. The @supports gate at :177 cannot catch it — CSS.supports for atan2 returns true in WebKit.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownership, dependency direction, public surface) for demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m]) — the model this seat was explicitly spawned with; declared, not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: L-1 — the ErrorBoundary latches the entire application dead across navigation. `caught` is component-local state on a component whose lifetime is the app's, while the failing unit is a pane keyed by `PaneSlot.liveKey`; the boundary can never learn the failure is stale. Live probe: after a catch, navigating to `/#/palettes` changes `location.hash` but `.pane-container` is still absent and the error plate still renders — the dock keeps accepting clicks over a corpse. Only a full reload recovers. The component's one job (recovery) does not work, and its Retry button is a visible no-op.
result.negativeProof: Not applicable to the verdict (DEFECTIVE), but recorded so later seats do not re-litigate the clean axes: (1) value.js consumption is clean BY ABSENCE — ErrorBoundary.vue:39-41 imports only `vue`, `@lucide/vue`, `../ui/button`; zero `@mkbabb/value.js`, zero `@src/*`, zero reach into `src/`. package.json#exports is a closed 8-key set and the file touches none of it, so there is no false proof of the public API — an external consumer could write this file verbatim given glass-ui. (2) Not a god module: 87 lines, one responsibility, no composables of its own. (3) `verbatimModuleSyntax` has nothing to violate — every imported binding is a value. (4) Vue 3.5 idioms correct: `useTemplateRef` at :57, reactive props destructure with defaults at :43-51, typed `defineEmits` at :53. (5) None of the named historical suspects (local useLayerTransition, usePaletteExport dual path, triplicate useDark) touch this file — it imports no composable at all. (6) `@lucide/vue` as a devDependency is correct: glass-ui declares it a peerDependency and the demo is not published (package.json#files = ["dist","!dist/gh-pages",...]). (7) The rendered plate itself is correct — the U-F58 a11y contract (role=alert, aria-live=assertive, focus-managed, named, visible affordance) is genuinely met; visual REPORT.md over 60 Safari captures shows pageErrors=0, blankOrNearBlank=0. The defect is that the affordance the plate offers is a lie, not that the plate is wrong.

demo/color-picker/App.vue:47-50 opens ONE boundary around the whole grid, closes at :139-141 (no @reset listener). `caught` is a bare ref at ErrorBoundary.vue:55; the failing unit is keyed at demo/shell/PaneSlot.vue:113-119 (`:key="liveKey"`). Live probe `node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/live-latch.mjs` output: instances_with_onErrorCaptured: [{"name":"ErrorBoundary","depth":1}] / after_catch: {"paneContainerPresent":false,"focusTag":"vj-error-boundary flex flex-col items-ce"} / after_navigation_to_/palettes: {"hash":"#/palettes","paneContainerPresent":false,"mainText":"This panel hit an unexpected error.

L-probe induced render throw

Try again"} / after_reload: {"alerts":1,"paneContainerPresent":true}. Unit probes P1+P2 in probes/boundary.test.ts (6/6 pass).
defects.mechanism: wrong-altitude ownership — state about "which pane is currently failing" is stored on the application, not on the pane; unique semantic ownership violated
defects.reproduction: 1) dev server at localhost:9000; 2) run `node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/live-latch.mjs` — it walks the live Vue tree, fires the single onErrorCaptured hook exactly as Vue's handleError does, then sets location.hash='#/palettes'; 3) observe hash changes to #/palettes while .pane-container remains absent and the error plate still renders. Isolated: `npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.config.ts` P2 — replace the slotted component outright, boundary stays latched, healthy replacement never mounts.

defects.defect: The boundary is a terminal, unreportable sink: `return false` suppresses Vue's own logError, the app installs no error handler of any kind, and the async failure class is structurally uncatchable.

The visual audit's one console error (audit/visual/REPORT.md §consoleErrors: 'safari-desktop-light /#/: WebGL: context lost.') is exactly this uncatchable class.

defects.reproduction: Textual — diff PreviewStrip.vue:56-65 against PreviewRamp.vue:40-49. Live: node scratchpad/PSL-probe.mjs → rect [42,16] on all rows; bgImage "none" on strips vs the gradient on ramps.
defects.proposedCure: One `PreviewChip.vue` (props: stops, mode?: "segments"|"gradient") in demo/shared/ui/ — 2 files/127 lines → 1 file/~55, one material block. AGGRESSIVE VARIANT, offered not hedged: drop `mode` and paint segments always — at the MEASURED 42 px chip width, RAMP_SAMPLE_COUNT=16 gives 2.6 px per segment, a ramp the eye reads as continuous. That deletes the gradient path, makes data-stops single-valued (L-7), and lets ONE oracle read segment backgroundColors for both forms, retiring o14's parseOklchTriples regex (already wanted at DEFECT-LEDGER.md:20786).

defects.defect: `data-stops` carries two mutually contradictory referents (truth-function output vs painted output); above the 7-segment cap the component's own documented truth law is false by construction.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:44 stamps `stampStops(stops)` (ALL stops) while the template at :49-51 paints `visible` = `stops.slice(0,7)` (:32-35). Measured live, both engines: `chromium · count=12 { n: 12, painted: 7 }`, `webkit · count=12 { n: 12, painted: 7 }`, `chromium · count=8 { n: 8, painted: 7 }`. The file's own header at :6-8 asserts "the strip stamps them on `data-stops` and paints them as equal hard segments". o14-preview-truth.spec.ts:33 states the law for the ramp species: "the painted gradient must embed exactly those stops".
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — one attribute overloaded with two referents that the cap makes provably unequal
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/generate -> focus the "Color count" slider -> ArrowRight to 12 -> open the "Generation preset" combobox -> for any chip: `el.getAttribute("data-stops").split("|").length === 12` while `el.children.length === 7`.
defects.proposedCure: Split the referents at the seam instead of overloading one attribute: the chip stamps WHAT IT PAINTS (`:data-stops="stampStops(visible)"`), and the host — which owns the truth function — stamps the total on the row it owns (`:data-preview-total="stops.length"` on the SelectItem). Then o14's paint-equals-stamp law becomes true for the strip species for the first time and o20's seed-exact law reads the whole truth-function output. Cleaner gestalt: delete the cap from the chip entirely — a chip whose job is "paint the stops you are given" has no business silently discarding five of them; let the host decide how many stops to hand over.

defects.mechanism: F-alpha — the affordance is applied to a child while the completeness signal (ring + corner clip) lives on the parent

defects.defect: The golden-plate law is asserted in `em` and written in `rem`; the plate measurably is not phi-squared, and the two engines disagree. `display: inline-flex` is inert dead code.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:59-60 — `inline-size: 2.618rem; /* one golden plate — φ² × 1em (F7) */` next to `block-size: 1em`. Measured live at the real call site: chip font-size 16.4px, root font-size 16px => Chromium `{ w: 41.875, h: 16.391, ratio: 2.5548 }`, WebKit `{ w: 41.944, h: 16.248, ratio: 2.5815 }`; phi^2 = 2.6180339887. 2.4% short in Chromium, 1.4% in WebKit. Identical defect verbatim at PreviewRamp.vue:43-44. Also measured `display: "flex"` in BOTH engines despite `display: inline-flex` at :57 — the chip is a flex item of the #description wrapper (GenerateControls.vue:244) and is blockified per CSS Display §2.7.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the shared law has no root, so its units drifted from its own comment
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/generate -> open Preset menu -> `getComputedStyle(chip)` and `chip.getBoundingClientRect()`: w/h = 2.5548 (Chromium) / 2.5815 (WebKit), display = "flex".
defects.proposedCure: One unit. `block-size: 1em; inline-size: calc(2.618 * 1em)` if the plate rides the line it joins (F7 says it does — "joins the description line"), or both in `rem` if it is an absolute plate. Not one of each. Delete the inert `inline-` prefix or make the chip not a flex item.

defects.defect: `.preview-chip` is minted twice in two disjoint `<style scoped>` blocks with no shared root, and has already drifted.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:56-65 (`display: inline-flex`, `overflow: hidden`, 2.618rem, 1em, --radius-sm, `inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 12%, transparent)`) vs PreviewRamp.vue:40-49 (`display: inline-block`, NO overflow, otherwise identical). Both scoped => they compile to `[data-v-A]` and `[data-v-B]`, two disjoint rules no single edit can reach. Drift already present: display differs, overflow differs, and the F7/F8 rationale comment survives only on the ramp. Violates the root-level-styling edict (5) and KISS (3).
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the primitive was never rooted
defects.reproduction: NONE required — read PreviewStrip.vue:56-65 against PreviewRamp.vue:40-49; the two `.preview-chip` blocks differ in `display` and `overflow` while claiming the same F7 law.
defects.proposedCure: The chip base is one thing; give it one home. Smallest honest move: a `color-chips/chip.css` imported by both SFCs (zero new directories — KISS-compliant). Idiomatic transposition under the glass-ui-is-the-design-system edict (4): a glass-ui primitive, where a reusable chip plate belongs and where `@mkbabb/glass-ui/chip` (`Chip`, `chipVariants`) already lives. Per-species deltas (inline-flex+overflow for the segmented form, gradient paint for the continuous form) stay in the SFCs as modifiers.

defects.defect: A third independent mint of the same visual primitive is imported into the same file and rendered on the same screen.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/browser/card/PaletteColorStrip.vue renders the identical primitive — n hard colour segments inside an `overflow-hidden` flex box — with weights and an 8% legibility floor (`WEIGHT_FLOOR = 0.08`). GenerateControls.vue imports BOTH: `:16 PaletteColorStrip`, `:20 PreviewStrip`, and renders both at `:135`, `:245`, `:274`. Prop shapes diverged (`PaletteColor[]` vs `readonly string[]`); a11y treatments diverged (`aria-hidden` alone vs `aria-hidden` + `role="presentation"`). color-chips/index.ts:2-4 claims the opposite: "ONE focused common module for the multi-feature chip grammar, never a per-pane copy".
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the primitive was never rooted; the per-pane copy predates the module and was never folded in
defects.reproduction: NONE required — `grep -n "PaletteColorStrip\|PreviewStrip" demo/workbenches/generate/GenerateControls.vue` shows both imported at :16 and :20.
defects.proposedCure: One segmented-strip primitive with a `segments` contract carrying an optional weight — equal widths are the degenerate case of weighted widths, so PreviewStrip is PaletteColorStrip + a size token + a cap, not a separate component. Under the design-system edict that primitive belongs in glass-ui alongside `Chip`; the two demo call sites then differ only by props. Today the weighted/floored maths is unavailable to the chips and the cap grammar is unavailable to the card strip (which will render 40 sub-pixel slivers for a 40-colour palette).

defects.defect: No honest-absence path for an unpaintable stop — the strip lacks the honesty contract its sibling ramp has, so an invalid stop paints transparent while `data-stops` still asserts a colour.
defects.evidence: Ramp side HAS one: `sampleInterpolationRamp` returns null on an unparseable operand (sample.ts:60-66) and the host v-ifs the chip away (MixConfigBar.vue:111,133). Strip side has none: PreviewStrip.vue:50 `:style="{ backgroundColor: stop }"` — a non-CSS string is silently dropped by the CSSOM (verified: invalid background-color strings are dropped by both Chromium and WebKit), segment paints transparent, menu ground shows through, stamp still claims a colour. sample.ts:15-19 forbids exactly this ("a chip that approximates the library output is FORBIDDEN"). Reachable-in-principle source: aurora-harmony-stops.ts:27,39 builds `oklch(${fmt(L)} ${fmt(C)} ${fmt(h)})` with `fmt(v)=v.toFixed(4).replace(/\.?0+$/,"")`, mapping NaN->"NaN" and Infinity->"Infinity".
defects.mechanism: leaf — asymmetric honesty contract between the two chip species
defects.reproduction: NONE — HYPOTHESIS. I verified only the mechanism (invalid background-color dropped by both engines); I did NOT find a live input producing a non-finite stop. I did verify `fmt`'s trailing-zero regex is CORRECT for finite input (100.0000->"100", 0.1000->"0.1", 0.0000->"0"), so that is not the hazard.
defects.proposedCure: Give the strip the same honesty contract as the ramp: validate at the module seam (sample.ts already owns "the ONE serialization") and let the host render nothing rather than a transparent lie.

defects.defect: A11y — the elision is conveyed solely by a decorative, aria-hidden alpha ramp, and the component's entire information payload is `background-color` with no forced-colors handling.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:43 `aria-hidden="true"`. When truncated, "5 of these 12 colours are not shown" has NO textual substitute in the row — the #description lane carries a static blurb (`GENERATION_PRESETS[p].description`, e.g. "High chroma, bold tones"; measured option text "VibrantHigh chroma, bold tones"), never a count. Under `forced-colors: active` the segments' background-color is replaced by the forced palette and the component declares no `forced-color-adjust`, so its entire payload disappears.
defects.mechanism: leaf — informative content marked decorative
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/generate -> count=12 -> open Preset menu -> accessible name/description of any option contains no colour and no count; the chip is aria-hidden.
defects.proposedCure: Decide which it is. If decorative, the row's description must carry the count when the strip truncates ("12 colours · showing 7" in the existing #description lane — no new surface). If informative, it stops being aria-hidden and gets a name. It cannot be both, and today it is informative-but-hidden.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation defects in demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id claude-opus-5[1m]; explicitly declared at spawn, not inherited
result.strongestDefect: C-1 — the decorative aurora canvas paints OVER the boundary's icon, headline and detail, so the "SR-ANNOUNCED, never a silent dead plate" surface renders as a blank field with one floating "Try again" button. Measured: darkest pixel inside the headline's own box vs its own background = 1.12:1 (detail 1.06:1); 86 and 42 distinct colours = pure gradient banding, zero glyph pixels. Applying `position: relative` to .vj-error-boundary at runtime (no source edit) restores 8.37:1 / 3.70:1 and 1323 / 499 distinct colours. Mechanism: .atmosphere-canvas is position:absolute z-index:auto full-viewport (CSS 2.1 painting step 8) while .vj-error-boundary is position:static (step 7); healthy panes escape only because .pane-wrapper carries position:relative z-index:1, and the boundary mounts OUTSIDE .pane-container, replacing the very element whose children carry that lift.
result.negativeProof: Checked and clean: no defineModel (stale-read hazard N/A); no colour maths, no ValueUnit wrapping, no stableHue (those hazards N/A); no requestAnimationFrame, timers, listeners or observers — nothing to leak, and the single nextTick callback is ?.-guarded and self-terminating; no parsing (the parseCssColor crash class N/A); no reka-ui slider (pointer-capture leak N/A); recovery button measures 124x36 px (above the 24 px tap floor) with accessible name "Try again", contributing nothing to the visual REPORT's nameless-button or small-tap-target counts; no per-frame or per-keystroke work — the component is inert until it catches; edicts 1 (no god module, 87 lines/one concern), 4 (Button is glass-ui's, via demo/ui/button/index.ts re-export), 6 (no animations to delete), 7 (useTemplateRef + reactive props destructure, idiomatic Vue 3.5) and 8 (verbatimModuleSyntax — no type-only imports present) all PASS.

defects.defect: The decorative, aria-hidden aurora canvas occludes the error boundary's icon, headline and detail; only the glass-ui recovery Button paints. The component's entire stated purpose ('NEVER a silent white-screen dead plate') is inverted — sighted users get a blank field with one floating button.
defects.evidence: Measured pixels (evidence/probe-live-pixels.mjs, 1440x900, dpr 1): SHIPPED head distinctColours 86, darkestPixel [255,128,176], contrastDarkestVsBg 1.12; detail distinctColours 42, darkestPixel [255,142,176], contrast 1.06. RUNTIME-LIFTED (.vj-error-boundary{position:relative} via evaluate, no source edit): head 1323 colours, darkestPixel [28,25,23], contrast 8.37; detail 499 colours, darkestPixel [86,84,83], contrast 3.70. Stacking (evidence/probe-live-stacking.mjs): canvas .atmosphere-canvas position:absolute z-index:auto rect 0,0,1440x900; div .vj-error-boundary position:static z-index:auto; healthy .pane-wrapper position:relative z-index:1; canvasCoversHeadline true. Screenshots evidence/02-shipped-crop-only-button-paints.png vs evidence/03-runtime-position-relative-restores-text.png. Source: demo/color-picker/App.vue:9-17 (canvas), App.vue:50 (boundary mounted outside .pane-container), ErrorBoundary.vue:15-22.
defects.mechanism: stacking-context / paint-order: the fallback replaces .pane-container but inherits none of .pane-wrapper's z-lift, so its static in-flow text paints in CSS 2.1 painting step 7, beneath the absolutely-positioned z-auto canvas in step 8. The Button survives only because glass-ui gives it position:relative + backdrop-filter.
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/evidence/probe-live-pixels.mjs (dev server on :9000). It route-intercepts **/BrowsePane.vue** with a component whose render throws, navigates to #/browse, screenshots, decodes the PNG in-browser and samples the headline's / detail's own bounding boxes.
defects.proposedCure: Do not hand-roll a second error plate. demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue:14-27 already IS the error plate (variant="error": same CircleAlert, same Fraunces statement, same plate-ink detail, same action slot) and ErrorBoundary.vue:12-14 admits it is a copy. Render <EmptyState variant="error"> inside the existing pane shell so the fallback lands on the same plate rung as the panes it replaces. This kills C-1, C-6 and C-12 in one architectural move and deletes ~20 lines of duplicated template.

defects.defect: The boundary latches for the rest of the session: `caught` is component-local with no key, no watcher and no route coupling, and App.vue wraps the ENTIRE two-pane grid in ONE boundary. After any pane throws, every subsequent navigation shows the same dead plate and the pane grid stays unmounted, while the dock (outside the boundary) remains fully operable.
defects.evidence: Live (evidence/probe-live-latching.mjs): state1 hash "#/browse" paneContainer false, main "This panel hit an unexpected error.INDUCED-AUDIT-THROW Try again"; state2 hash "#/" paneContainer false, identical text; state3 hash "#/mix" paneContainer false, identical text. Unit probe C-E: '[C-E] error plate still rendered: true / healthy pane mounted: false'. Source: demo/color-picker/App.vue:50-140 (one boundary, whole grid); ErrorBoundary.vue:55 (const caught = ref(false), no key/watch).
defects.mechanism: unresettable local latch at the wrong granularity — the boundary's v-else withholds the whole grid, and nothing re-arms it on route change.
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/evidence/probe-live-latching.mjs — induces the throw at #/browse, then sets location.hash to #/ and #/mix and re-samples main.pane-main; plus `npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.challenge-c.config.ts` (probe C-E).
defects.proposedCure: Scope + key. One boundary per pane slot, mounted inside demo/shell/PaneSlot.vue and keyed on the pane key — a new route is a new boundary instance, born un-caught — so one pane's failure can take out neither its sibling nor its successor.

defects.defect: Total diagnostic blackout. `return false` in onErrorCaptured makes Vue's handleError return early, before app.config.errorHandler AND before logError; the component logs nothing itself and emits nothing on catch. The stack is destroyed.
defects.evidence: Unit probe C-B: 'boundary painted: true / console.error mentioning the throw: false / console.warn mentioning the throw: false / app.config.errorHandler invocations: 0 / component emissions on catch: {}'. Live: the full console+pageerror capture for the session contains zero mention of INDUCED-AUDIT-THROW (only unrelated dev-misconfig, 'No available adapters', WebGL ReadPixels stall, and 'Failed to load remote palettes'). Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:59-69.
defects.mechanism: suppressing propagation and suppressing observability conflated into one `return false`.
defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.challenge-c.config.ts (probe C-B); and node evidence/probe-live-latching.mjs, whose `log` array shows no INDUCED-AUDIT-THROW entry.
defects.proposedCure: Log before suppressing: `console.error("[ErrorBoundary]", err, info)` immediately above the `return false`, so the boundary owns the UI failure without also erasing the evidence. This restores parity with the repo's own honesty contract that App.vue:144-149 is at pains to preserve elsewhere.

defects.defect: 'Focus-managed' is half-implemented in two ways: (a) focus is never RESTORED — reset() destroys the focused Button and activeElement falls to <body>, teleporting the keyboard user to the top of the document; (b) focus lands on the tabindex=-1 role=alert CONTAINER, not on the recovery affordance the header comment promises, which is the WAI-ARIA APG anti-pattern (double announcement) and shows no focus ring to a sighted keyboard user.
defects.evidence: Unit probe C-D: 'activeElement after catch: DIV alert' / 'activeElement before reset: BUTTON' / 'error plate gone: true' / 'activeElement AFTER reset: BODY (=== document.body)'. Live state4 after pressing Try again: "activeEl": "BODY[]". Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:8-10 (the claim), :21 (tabindex=-1 on the container), :64 (nextTick(() => alertRef.value?.focus())), :71-75 (reset with no restore).
defects.mechanism: one-way focus management — an enter hook with no exit hook, aimed at the container rather than the control.
defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.challenge-c.config.ts (probe C-D).
defects.proposedCure: Capture document.activeElement at catch time; move focus to the recovery Button (a real, named, focus-visible control) rather than the alert container; on reset restore the captured element if still connected, else the pane's first heading. Let the live region do the announcing.

defects.defect: 'Try again' is a no-op loop whenever the cause persists — reset() only flips local state and remounts the identical subtree with identical inputs — and the escape hatch that would let the parent fix anything is unwired: `emit("reset")` has no listener anywhere.
defects.evidence: Unit probe C-C: '[C-C] after Try again, error plate still present: true'. `grep -n "@reset\|onReset" demo/color-picker/App.vue` returns no matches; App.vue:50 declares no handler. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:53 (defineEmits), :74 (emit), :11 ('a real recovery <button> — never a terminal dead end'). The repo's own induced failure (e2e/smoke/admin/a11y-authed-admin.spec.ts:113-130, a contract-violating /admin/users payload the panel refetches on mount) is exactly this deterministic class.
defects.mechanism: dead API surface — a recovery seam that looks like one and is not; the reset path has no cache invalidation, no refetch, no remount key.
defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.challenge-c.config.ts (probe C-C).
defects.proposedCure: Pick one: either App.vue handles @reset (invalidate the pane's cache / bump a remount key / re-run the failed fetch), or the emit is deleted and reset bumps a local key on the slot. Not both, not neither — under edict 2 the current unwired emit is a dead path.

defects.defect: The detail line rides `--ink-muted`, a rung certified against the RESTING GLASS PLATE, on a surface that has no plate. Measured 3.70:1 at 16.4 px — below the WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 4.5:1 floor. The component's own style comment asserts it 'adds NO sub-floor contrast debt'.
defects.evidence: Measured contrast 3.70:1 (evidence/probe-live-pixels.mjs, RUNTIME-LIFTED detail: darkestPixel [86,84,83], bgEstimate [255,151,176], contrastDarkestVsBg 3.70), font-size 16.4px Fira Code. Token provenance: demo/color-session/useContrastSafeColor.ts:324-330 certifies via surfaceLightnessNow("resting", ...), documented at :283-285 ('the referent is the SURFACE RUNG, never the bare page ambient'); stamped by demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphereBoot.ts:100-106. Claim under test: ErrorBoundary.vue:79-86.

defects.proposedCure: C-1's cure. Putting the fallback back on the plate makes the rung true again by construction, rather than re-deriving a second certified ink for a plateless surface.

defects.defect: Vacuous gate: zero unit tests, one e2e test, and that test cannot fail for any finding above. Its strongest content assertion reads textContent, which is fully present while the glyphs are 100% occluded; Playwright's `visible` filter means non-empty box, not un-occluded. It never clicks the recovery button.
defects.evidence: grep -rn 'ErrorBoundary' over demo/ src/ test/ e2e/ yields only App.vue:50/:180 and two comment lines in e2e/smoke/admin/a11y-authed-admin.spec.ts. @vue/test-utils@2.4.11 has zero importers under test/ or demo/test/ (vitest.config.ts:21 include = ["test/**/*.ts","demo/test/**/*.ts"]). Spec :142-143 `expect(alertText.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)`; :136 `getByRole("alert").filter({visible:true}).first()`; :152-155 asserts the button is visible but never activates it.
defects.mechanism: assertions on DOM truth rather than painted truth, plus an untested second half (recovery).
defects.reproduction:
Named mutations that keep vitest + playwright + vue-tsc + eslint green: M1 `return false` -> `return;` (line 68); M2 `function reset() {}` empty body; M3 delete defineEmits + emit("reset"); M4 delete the `vj-error-boundary` token from line 18; M5 change the `message` default to any string; M6 delete the whole `

` block (alertText stays non-empty from the headline).
defects.proposedCure: The gate must assert painted truth using the same pixel-sampling method as this report (darkest-glyph-vs-background contrast inside the text box), plus a real unit suite for the state machine: latch, re-arm on key change, focus restore, emit wiring.

defects.defect: `vj-error-boundary` is a dead hook class: declared on the fallback root, matched by no CSS rule anywhere and no test selector.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "vj-error-boundary" demo/ src/ e2e/` returns exactly one line: demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:18. It appears in neither demo/styles/ nor the SFC's own scoped block (ErrorBoundary.vue:78-86 defines only .plate-ink).
defects.mechanism: dead path — a styling/selection hook nothing consumes.
defects.reproduction: grep -rn "vj-error-boundary" demo/ src/ e2e/
defects.proposedCure: Delete it, or make it load-bearing by moving the boundary's plate styling onto it (which C-1's cure would supersede anyway).

defects.defect: The aria-live region is created in the same commit as its content (v-if), which Safari/VoiceOver — the very engine the mega-tranche's visual matrix audits — announces unreliably. The announcement that does occur comes from the focus move, a different mechanism than the WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages one the header claims. `aria-live="assertive"` is additionally redundant on role="alert".
defects.evidence: Unit probe C-F: '[C-F] pre-error [aria-live] count: 0 / pre-error [role=alert] count: 0'; the pre-error DOM is an HTML comment plus the slot. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:15-22 (v-if="caught" on the node that carries role+aria-live), :6-7 (the WCAG 4.1.3 claim).

defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.challenge-c.config.ts (probe C-F).
defects.proposedCure: Keep an always-mounted empty live region and write into it; or, with C-1's cure, let EmptyState's own role="alert" carry it and stop double-declaring the register.

defects.defect: The machine-truth detail is unbounded and unclamped: any error message renders verbatim at full height inside an h-full justify-center flex column with no overflow, pushing the only recovery affordance off the plate. It also leaks raw internal error text to end users in production.
defects.evidence: Unit probe C-G: '[C-G] rendered detail length: 4000' with classes 'text-mono-small plate-ink max-w-[46ch] break-words' — width bounded, height unbounded. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:27-29, :18 (h-full, no overflow).
defects.mechanism: unbounded growth of untrusted-length content in a centred, non-scrolling flex column.
defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.challenge-c.config.ts (probe C-G throws new Error('X'.repeat(4000))).
defects.proposedCure: Clamp (line-clamp-3 plus a disclosure for the full text) and gate the raw machine text behind import.meta.env.DEV, leaving a stable user-facing statement in production.

defects.defect: A second role="alert" node exists in the same document (DockStatusLamp's dev-misconfig variant, in nav, which precedes main), so the U-F58 e2e's `getByRole("alert").filter({visible:true}).first()` can bind the lamp rather than the boundary and assert aria-live/focus-containment on the wrong node.
defects.evidence: demo/shell/dock/status-lamp.ts:39 (`role: "alert" | "status"`) and :53 (`role: "alert"` for the dev-misconfig variant); demo/shell/dock/DockStatusLamp.vue:16 binds it. Measured live with the boundary mounted AND caught: document.querySelector('[role="alert"]').textContent === "dev misconfigured — run `npm run dev`", while document.activeElement was the boundary DIV[alert]. e2e locator at e2e/smoke/admin/a11y-authed-admin.spec.ts:136.
