defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/evidence/probe-live-latching.mjs — state1..state3 report alertText "dev misconfigured — run `npm run dev`" while mainText is the boundary's. HYPOTHESIS for the e2e environment specifically: the lamp is presumably absent there (VITE_API_URL is set on the e2e origin), so this is measured fragility, not an observed e2e failure.
defects.proposedCure: Bind the boundary by a stable data-testid in the spec, not by role-and-hope.

defects.defect: `.plate-ink` is copy-pasted as an identical scoped declaration into seven components; ErrorBoundary is the seventh copy. The `var(--ink-muted, var(--muted-foreground))` fallback arm is additionally unreachable and can only mask a boot regression.
defects.evidence: Identical `color: var(--ink-muted, var(--muted-foreground));` at demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue:102, demo/workbenches/extract/ExtractWorkbench.vue:290, demo/workbenches/extract/ImageDropZone.vue:109, demo/workbenches/extract/ExtractControls.vue:148, demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:205, demo/picker/display/ColorComponentDisplay/ColorComponentDisplay.vue:200/205/211, demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:84. Unreachability: useAtmosphereBoot.ts:100-106 stamps --ink-muted in a watch(..., {immediate:true}) during App setup, before any pane can render.
defects.mechanism: per-instance styling duplication instead of one root utility (edict 5), plus a masking fallback (edict 2).
defects.reproduction: grep -rn 'plate-ink' demo/ (7 scoped blocks); grep -rn -- '--ink-muted' demo/ (the boot writer at useAtmosphereBoot.ts:103).
defects.proposedCure: One `@utility plate-ink` in demo/styles/foundation.css replacing all seven scoped blocks, with the dead fallback arm dropped. Inherited idiom, not this component's invention — but ErrorBoundary should not add the seventh copy.

defects.defect: The boundary structurally cannot catch this app's actual failure mode: onErrorCaptured covers render/lifecycle/watcher/handler throws, not rejected promises, and every real failure surface here is async. The repo's only induced-error test therefore exercises the one failure class the app does not actually have.
defects.evidence: In the same live session that produced C-1..C-6, a genuine app failure was logged and never reached the boundary: 'warning: Failed to load remote palettes: DevMisconfigError: value.js dev is MISCONFIGURED: …'. Claim under test: ErrorBoundary.vue:4 ('When any descendant pane throws during render / lifecycle') vs the surrounding prose at :2-3 ('NEVER a silent white-screen dead plate').
defects.mechanism: scope claim in the header narrower than the promise the component is mounted to keep.
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/evidence/probe-live-latching.mjs — inspect the `log` array; the palette-fetch failure is present and the boundary never fired for it.
defects.proposedCure: Either narrow the promise in the comment to what onErrorCaptured actually covers, or pair the boundary with an explicit async-failure surface (the panes' own EmptyState variant="error") so the two halves together make the claim true.

defects.defect: reset() remounts the whole pane tree — KeepAlive cache and the GooBlob WebGL2 context included — and nothing in demo/ ever releases a WebGL context, so a looping recovery button (C-5) churns contexts against the browser's ~16 cap.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "loseContext\|WEBGL_lose_context" demo/` returns no matches. docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/REPORT.md already records the single console error across 60 captures as 'safari-desktop-light /#/: WebGL: context lost.' Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:71-75 (reset unmounts the whole slot), App.vue:50-140 (the slot is the whole pane grid).
defects.mechanism: unbounded context creation without explicit release, driven by a recovery affordance that invites repeated presses.
defects.reproduction: NONE — hypothesis. No exhaustion repro was run; the grep and the pre-existing REPORT.md context-lost row are the only evidence.
defects.proposedCure: Belongs to the WebGL lane, not this one: explicit WEBGL_lose_context release in the metaball renderer's unmount path. Scoping the boundary per pane (C-2's cure) also stops a browse-pane failure from tearing down the picker's context at all.

defects.defect: App.vue re-passes the component's own default verbatim, so one of the two is dead and the default is untested by the only consumer.
defects.evidence: demo/color-picker/App.vue:50 `message="This panel hit an unexpected error."` is byte-identical to demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:44 `message = "This panel hit an unexpected error."`.
defects.mechanism: duplicated literal across the prop boundary.
defects.reproduction: Read demo/color-picker/App.vue:50 and demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:43-45.
defects.proposedCure: Drop the prop at the call site (the default is the design intent) or drop the default (the caller is the authority). Under edict 3 the duplication should not survive.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-system boundary, proportion/seat law)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 — exact model ID `claude-opus-5[1m]`. This matches the explicit declaration in my spawn prompt; the seat is declared, not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: D-1 — The boundary's ink is painted UNDER the `position:absolute` atmosphere canvas, so the shipped caught state renders a single wordless "Try again" pill on an empty pink field. The component's stated thesis (`ErrorBoundary.vue:2-3`: "NEVER a silent white-screen dead plate") is falsified by its own pixels. Proven three ways — the shipped frame `evidence/EB1-caught-desktop-1440-light.png`; computed styles showing the canvas at `position:absolute / z-index:auto / tree-index 0 / 1440x900` above a `position:static` boundary whose only `position:relative` child (the glass-ui Button) is the only child that paints; and a one-property cure test (`evidence/EB8-cure-test-position-relative.png`) where adding `position:relative` alone restores all three hidden children. Independently corroborated by the Markdown seat's pre-existing `../Markdown/evidence/E6-doc-load-failure-whole-route-collapse.png`. The defect is invisible to every DOM-level probe because the canvas is `pointer-events:none`, so `elementFromPoint`, rects, computed styles and the a11y tree all report a healthy plate.
result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, so no negative is claimed. For completeness, the axes that ARE clean, with positive evidence: (1) Vue 3.5 idioms (edict 7) — `useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>("alertRef")` at ErrorBoundary.vue:57, reactive props destructure with defaults at 43-51 (not `withDefaults`), type-only `defineProps`/`defineEmits`; correct on all three counts. (2) `verbatimModuleSyntax` (edict 8) — lines 39-41 import only runtime values (`ref`, `nextTick`, `onErrorCaptured`, `useTemplateRef`, `CircleAlert`, `RotateCcw`, `Button`); there are no type-only imports to mark, so nothing to violate. (3) Component-boundary provenance — `demo/ui/button/index.ts` is a one-line `export { Button } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`, so the producer component is used, not re-implemented (only its styling is per-instance overridden, D-6). (4) No god module / no legacy shim — 87 lines, single purpose, zero aliases, dual paths or back-compat arms. (5) `return false` from `onErrorCaptured` (line 68) correctly halts propagation to `app.config.errorHandler`, which is what a boundary owning the failure should do. (6) Hover/press/disabled states are correctly delegated to the glass-ui Button rather than re-styled.

defects.defect: The boundary root is `position: static` and paints beneath the `position: absolute` full-viewport atmosphere canvas. Three of its four children (alert glyph, Fraunces statement, Fira detail) never render; only the glass-ui Button, which is `position: relative`, survives. The shipped caught state is a wordless pill on an empty field — the exact 'silent dead plate' the component's header comment says it exists to prevent.
defects.evidence: evidence/EB1-caught-desktop-1440-light.png (only 'Try again' visible). evidence/EB-probe2.json → occlusion: canvasStyle {position:absolute, zIndex:auto}, canvasRect {0,0,1440,900}, canvasDomIndexInLayout 0; boundaryStyle {position:static, zIndex:auto}; childStyles svg/msg/detail = static, button = relative. hitTest returns `p.font-display.text-heading` for the invisible message because the canvas is pointer-events:none (App.vue:11). Cure test evidence/EB8-cure-test-position-relative.png: setting only `style.position='relative'` restores all three. Independent prior capture: ../Markdown/evidence/E6-doc-load-failure-whole-route-collapse.png. Source: demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:15-22; demo/color-picker/App.vue:9-17,50.
defects.mechanism: F1 — the boundary replaced a stage instead of occupying a seat. CSS 2.1 Appendix E painting order: positioned descendants (step 8) paint above in-flow inline content (step 5). The element it displaces, `.pane-container`, carries `position: relative` (demo/styles/shell.css:74) and `.pane-wrapper--left` carries `z-index: 1` (shell.css:94-96); the bare div that replaces them inherits neither. Because the canvas is pointer-events:none, every DOM-level assertion passes while the pixels are blank — which is why the 60-capture visual matrix reports blankOrNearBlank: 0.
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/eb-probe.mjs — WebKit, viewport 1440x900, `page.route(/\/assets\/docs\/[a-z-]+\.md/, r => r.abort('failed'))`, goto http://localhost:9000/#/, wait 9s. Screenshot shows only the button; DOM reports all four children present with non-zero rects, opacity 1, visibility visible.
defects.proposedCure: Do not bolt `position: relative` onto the div — that patches the symptom. Move the boundary INSIDE `PaneSlot` so the failing pane's own wrapper renders the fallback in place of its child. The seat already owns the stacking layer, the glass material, the `cqi` container and the `vj-enter` grammar, so the bug becomes structurally impossible. This one transposition also closes D-2, D-4, D-9 and D-13.

defects.defect: A single caught error bricks the entire application permanently. Every one of the app's routes becomes unreachable: the dock keeps accepting navigation and updating the hash, but the scene never changes. The boundary also wraps BOTH panes, so a throw in the right pane destroys the healthy left pane.
defects.evidence: evidence/EB-probe2.json → brick[]: all 9 probed routes (#/palettes, #/browse, #/extract, #/mix, #/generate, #/gradient, #/atmosphere, #/blob, #/admin/users) return {boundaryStillUp: true, paneContainer: false} with the hash correctly updated. evidence/EB-measurements.json → EB5.post: afterRouteHash '#/gradient', afterRouteBoundary true, afterRouteText 'This panel hit an unexpected error.…'. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:55 (`caught` written only in onErrorCaptured), :71-75 (cleared only in reset()), :35 (`<slot v-else />`); App.vue:50→140 wraps the whole `.pane-container`.
defects.mechanism: F1 — wrong granularity plus no discharge. One boundary around the entire two-pane grid, and no watcher ties `caught` to the route. Because the slot lives in the `v-else` arm, a route change re-renders nothing. Violates PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-08 (recovery is ADD-AFFORDANCE at the entity) and VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5 ('Persistent operation state stays with the entity/workspace').
defects.reproduction: node .../eb-probe2.mjs — after the catch, loop `window.location.hash = h` over all routes, wait 700ms each, assert `!!document.querySelector('.vj-error-boundary')`. Returns true for every route.
defects.proposedCure: One boundary per pane seat (falls out of D-1's cure), keyed on the route so navigation naturally discharges the caught state. A failure in About must leave Picker standing.

defects.defect: The sole recovery affordance cannot recover. Clicking 'Try again' re-mounts the identical subtree with identical inputs, so a deterministic failure re-throws inside the same tick; the plate returns and focus is dragged back off the button onto the container, re-firing the assertive alert.
defects.evidence: evidence/EB-measurements.json → EB5.post: beforeBoundary true → click `.vj-error-boundary button` → afterRetryBoundary true, afterRetryActive {tag: 'div', cls: 'vj-error-boundary flex flex-col items-center justify-center '}. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:71-75 (`reset()` flips `caught` and clears `detail`, nothing else), :64 (`nextTick(() => alertRef.value?.focus())`).
defects.mechanism: F2 — the recovery affordance is decorative. `reset()` changes no input to the failing subtree: no remount key bump, no refetch, no attempt counter, no escalated copy, no alternative exit. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §3.1 requires a recovery article to offer 'diagnosis, preservation/export, then separately confirmed reset'; this offers one verb that provably does nothing.
defects.reproduction: node .../eb-probe.mjs (EB5 case) — after the catch, `page.click('.vj-error-boundary button')`, wait 2.5s, re-inspect. Boundary still present, activeElement is the container div again.
defects.proposedCure: A retry must change an input — bump a remount key on the slot, refetch the failed resource, or hand the user a named route escape. After the first failed retry the plate must escalate (say the retry failed and offer the escape) rather than re-arm the same dead verb.

defects.defect: The plate has no material tier — it paints directly onto the raw ambient aurora field with no glass, well or surface behind it. Five of six measured contrasts fail their floor; in dark scheme all three fail, including the destructive glyph (the only non-textual failure register) at 1.24:1 against a 3.0 floor.
defects.evidence: evidence/EB-probe3.json (ink hidden, exact child rects screenshot-clipped, pixels averaged). LIGHT: statement rgb(28,25,23) on rgb(242,93,163) = 5.72:1 PASS; detail rgb(86,84,83) @16.4px = 2.46:1 FAIL(4.5); glyph rgb(219,36,36) = 1.60:1 FAIL(3.0). DARK: statement rgb(233,230,226) = 2.46:1 FAIL; detail rgb(221,218,216) = 2.20:1 FAIL; glyph rgb(235,71,71) = 1.24:1 FAIL. Backdrop is rgb(242,93,163) in BOTH schemes — the ambient field does not darken (evidence/EB12-cured-dark-1440.png). Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:12-14 and :79-86 offer the token name as the evidence; useAtmosphereBoot.ts:85 certifies --ink-muted 'floor-clamped against the live resting plate'; EmptyState.vue:50-53 records the static token it replaced at 3.84:1.
defects.mechanism: F1 — the certified rung's referent is absent. `--ink-muted` is clamped against the resting glass plate; this surface has no plate, because it replaced the grid that held the Cards. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4.1 verbatim: 'Text, focus, boundaries and state meet their rendered contrast on the actual material tier; a token name is not evidence.' §2: 'One surface has one tier.' This surface has none.
defects.reproduction: node .../eb-probe3.mjs — for each scheme: catch, lift the plate above the canvas, record each child's computed `color`, set all children `visibility:hidden`, `page.screenshot({clip: childRect})`, decode in-page and mean the pixels, then compute WCAG relative-luminance contrast.
defects.proposedCure: Seat the fallback on a real producer material — glass-ui 7.0.0 exports both `./surface` and `./card` (node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/package.json subpaths). D-1's cure (render inside the pane seat) supplies the tier for free and needs no new token or per-instance background.

defects.defect: The plate is a fork of `EmptyState`'s `error` variant rather than a use of it. Its own comment says it 'mirrors' that variant; every magnitude drifted, and the `.plate-ink` CSS rule is cloned byte-for-byte. The shared atom already accepts exactly the four things needed (variant, message, detail, #action slot).
defects.evidence: gap 10px→12px (EmptyState.vue:16 `gap-2.5` vs ErrorBoundary.vue:18 `gap-3`); block padding 32px→40px (`py-8` vs `py-10`); glyph 24px→28px (:19 `w-6 h-6` vs :23 `w-7 h-7`); statement measure 26ch→28ch (:20 vs :24); detail measure 44ch→46ch (:23 vs :27); `.plate-ink` rule identical (EmptyState.vue:102-104 == ErrorBoundary.vue:84-86). EmptyState.vue:98-100 declares itself 'the ONE shared empty atom (8 consumers incl. the admin walls), so every consumer inherits the cure'; its props at :72-91 already expose variant/message/detail/#action.
defects.mechanism: F3 — the plate is a fork, not a use. Two sources of truth for one visual species; five unmotivated magnitudes with no rationale in either file. The next contrast or type cure applied to the shared atom will silently miss the one surface that appears when everything has gone wrong. Owner edict 3 (KISS, no contrivance); PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §3 ('Multiple instances sharing one cause share one family row plus an exhaustive site list').
defects.reproduction: NONE — static, exhaustive class-by-class diff of demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue:14-27 against demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:15-34, plus `grep -rn 'plate-ink' demo/`.
defects.proposedCure: Render `<EmptyState variant="error" :message :detail><template #action><Button …/></template></EmptyState>` and become its 9th consumer. Zero new magnitudes; the fork and the cloned `.plate-ink` block both die.

defects.defect: Type-jurisdiction violation, measured not inferred: Fraunces is applied to two roles the closed type matrix assigns to Plus Jakarta Sans. The button's family comes from a per-instance `class="font-display"` on a glass-ui root; `mt-1` on the same line breaks the plate's own gap rhythm at exactly one interval.
defects.evidence:
evidence/EB-measurements.json → EB1.state.children computed styles: statement `

` = Fraunces 25.888px / 35.596 lh / weight 700, but VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4 maps `section heading → text-heading → Plus Jakarta Sans`; button label = Fraunces 16.4px / weight 500, but §4 maps `control or label → text-small → Plus Jakarta Sans, non-bold`. §4: 'This matrix is closed across all eighteen compositions' with P019's Picker pair the sole exception. Rhythm, measured from the same rects: svg.bottom 436.7 → msg.top 448.7 = 12.0px; msg.bottom 484.3 → detail.top 496.3 = 12.0px; detail.bottom 519.2 → button.top 535.3 = 16.1px. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:24, :30.
defects.mechanism: F3 — per-instance override where the root should own the style. Owner edict 5 (style at the glass/shadcn root, never per-instance) and edict 4 (a Fraunces button is a glass-ui Button variant, not a class bolted onto one call site). `mt-1` adds 4px to one of three intervals with no stated reason.
defects.reproduction: node .../eb-probe.mjs — read `getComputedStyle` font-family/size/weight and `getBoundingClientRect` for each of the four children of `.vj-error-boundary` in the caught state.
defects.proposedCure: Delete `class="font-display mt-1"` from ErrorBoundary.vue:30. If a Fraunces action label is genuinely wanted, add it as a glass-ui Button variant at the producer. Let the statement take the Plus Jakarta `text-heading` the matrix assigns, or use the registered Fraunces role (`--type-title`) if identity weight is intended.

defects.defect: Focus is programmatically thrown to an unnamed 1408x804 container instead of the recovery button; the resulting focus ring encloses 87% of the viewport, and in the shipped state it does not paint at all because it is occluded by the same canvas as D-1. The container also fires an assertive alert AND moves focus into itself, racing the two announcements, and exposes no accessible name and zero headings.
defects.evidence: evidence/EB-measurements.json → EB1.state.activeElement = {tag:'div', cls:'vj-error-boundary …', outline:'auto 3px rgb(28,25,23)', boxShadow:'none'}; boundaryRect {w:1408, h:804}. Ring visible as a full-band rectangle in evidence/EB8-cure-test-position-relative.png, EB12, EB10 — and absent in the shipped EB1. evidence/EB-probe3.json → mobile.a11y: {role:'alert', ariaLive:'assertive', ariaLabel:null, ariaLabelledby:null, tabindex:'-1', headingsInside:0, isActive:true, tabbables:['button:Try again']}. Caught document headingCount 0 (EB1) vs healthy 1 (EB6). REPORT.md h1 column is 0 across all 60 captures. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:19-21, :62-64.
defects.mechanism: F2 — announcement and focus are aimed at the container rather than the verb. `role="alert"` already implies aria-live=assertive + aria-atomic=true, so the explicit aria-live at :20 is redundant; the real defect is doing both announce and move. Under D-3 this fires again on every failed retry. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4.1: 'Focus remains visibly distinct from selection in both schemes, forced colors and reduced transparency.'
defects.reproduction: node .../eb-probe.mjs — after the catch, read `document.activeElement`, its rect and its computed outline; then node .../eb-probe3.mjs mobile case for the ARIA attribute snapshot.
defects.proposedCure: Announce through the `role="alert"` region and move focus to the named recovery button, which carries its own accessible name and the producer-owned `focus-ring` recipe. Drop `aria-live`, drop `tabindex="-1"`, drop the container `focus()`. Give the failure statement a heading level so it has an entry point.

defects.defect: Raw JS stack traces are shipped to the end user as centre-aligned, unbounded, non-LTR-isolated body copy, with no disclosure, no truncation and no copy affordance.
defects.evidence: evidence/EB10-zoom200-long-detail-clip.png shows six ragged centre-set lines: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toFixed) at readoutReservation (readoutReservation.ts:118:24) at renderComponentRoot (vue.js:6521:16) at ReactiveEffect.componentUpdateFn (vue.js:7663:46)'. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:61 `detail.value = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)` (unbounded, unfiltered); :27 renders it inside the `text-center` column declared at :18.
defects.mechanism: F4 — the design was written, not rendered. Code set with ragged left AND right edges is unreadable; there is no clamp, `<details>` or truncation, so the plate's height is whatever the runtime hands it; VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §6.1 requires 'CSS strings, hex, slugs, IDs and provenance render in LTR-isolated spans' and there is no dir="ltr"/unicode-bidi:isolate; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.6 requires an affordance where the surviving state is otherwise undiscoverable — the one useful artefact on screen cannot be captured. The `v-if="detail"` guard at :27 is also dead: an Error always yields a non-empty message.
defects.reproduction: node .../eb-probe3.mjs zoom200 case — after the catch, set the detail element's textContent to a realistic stack trace and screenshot at 720x450.
defects.proposedCure: Left-align the mono provenance line, isolate it (`dir="ltr"`, `unicode-bidi: isolate`), clamp it to two lines with a disclosure for the rest, and attach the producer copy affordance. The plate's statement is the product copy; the trace is provenance and must be typeset as provenance.

defects.defect: `h-full w-full` stretches a content-hug plate species into a full page region. At 1440x900 the ink occupies 6.39% of the boundary; at 720x450 it nearly fills it. The plate has no intrinsic proportion — it is whatever the band is.
defects.evidence: evidence/EB-measurements.json → EB1: boundaryRect 1408x804 = 1,132,032 px²; ink bbox from svg.top 408.7 to button.bottom 571.3 (162.6) by widest child 444.9 = 72,341 px² → 6.39% ink, 93.6% empty. evidence/EB10-zoom200-long-detail-clip.png at 720x450: boundary 688x338 with content nearly filling it. The species it copies is a content-hug: EmptyState.vue:16 is `py-8` with no h-full. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:18.
defects.mechanism: F1 — a bounded plate stretched into a page region by two utility classes. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §3.2: 'Empty secondary content occupies at most a narrow invitation tray (≤15% of the stage) or disappears. It never receives half the viewport.' §7: 'A true empty invitation content-hugs its text/action.' PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.1: 'A Card houses one bounded object/specimen. A page region, empty column, inner stage or mere padding group does not become a Card by default' — inverted here.
defects.reproduction: node .../eb-probe.mjs — read the boundary rect and every child rect at 1440x900; node .../eb-probe3.mjs zoom200 case for 720x450.
defects.proposedCure: Delete `h-full w-full min-h-0` from ErrorBoundary.vue:18 and let the plate content-hug inside the pane seat (D-1's cure), exactly as its sibling species does.

defects.defect: The retry icon uses the physical `mr-1.5` instead of the logical `me-1.5`, so in RTL the icon-to-label gap collapses to 0px and 6px of dead space lands at the capsule's inner edge.
defects.evidence: evidence/EB-probe2.json, same page with `document.documentElement.dir` toggled. LTR: button.x 658.0 w 123.9, svg.x 670.0 (= 658 + 12px padding-left), marginRight '6px' → 6px icon→label gap. RTL: button.x 658.0 w 123.9, svg.x 750.0, icon right edge 764.0, button right edge 781.9 → 17.9px = 12px padding + the stray 6px on the outside; icon→label gap 0px. marginRight reported '6px' in both directions. Source: ErrorBoundary.vue:31.
defects.mechanism: F3 — a physical margin on an icon inside a bidi-agnostic capsule. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §6.1: 'chrome, navigation and layout | logical inline/block direction follows the document.'
defects.reproduction: node .../eb-probe2.mjs — after the catch, measure button/svg boundingClientRect and computed marginLeft/marginRight, set documentElement.dir='rtl', wait 300ms, re-measure.
defects.proposedCure: `me-1.5`. Better per edict 5: let the glass-ui Button own its icon-slot gap at the producer root so no call site sets an icon margin at all.

defects.defect: `var(--ink-muted, var(--muted-foreground))` is a masking fallback that silently re-admits the exact sub-floor contrast defect the certified rung exists to cure. The identical declaration is replicated across 11 sites in 7 SFCs.
defects.evidence: ErrorBoundary.vue:85. `--ink-muted` is stamped on documentElement unconditionally at App setup with `immediate: true` (useAtmosphereBoot.ts:100-106), so on the ready path the fallback arm is unreachable; where it IS reachable (boot failure) it restores the static token EmptyState.vue:50-53 records as measuring 3.84:1 against a 4.5:1 floor. Sites: EmptyState.vue:103, ErrorBoundary.vue:85, ExtractWorkbench.vue:291, ExtractControls.vue:149, ImageDropZone.vue:110, ConfigSliderPane.vue:205, ColorComponentDisplay.vue:200,205,211, PaneHeader.vue:123, ColorSpaceSelector.vue:309.
defects.mechanism: F3 — owner edict 2 forbids masking fallbacks. The fallback converts a boot failure into a silent contrast regression instead of a visible fault, and the replication means the same masking arm must be cured 11 times.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static: `grep -rn 'ink-muted' demo/` plus reading useAtmosphereBoot.ts:100-106 for the unconditional immediate stamp.
defects.proposedCure: One root `@utility plate-ink` in demo/styles/ referencing `var(--ink-muted)` with NO fallback arm, consumed by all 7 SFCs. If the rung is missing, that is a boot failure and must read as one.

defects.defect: `.vj-error-boundary` is a dead class hook — no stylesheet anywhere in the repository targets it.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "vj-error-boundary" demo/ src/ e2e/ test/` returns exactly one non-audit hit: demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:18, its own declaration. Its only other uses are audit probe selectors (docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/Markdown/probe-C6.mjs:34-35 and my own probes).
defects.mechanism: F3 — a named hook that nothing styles is either an unbuilt intention or noise. Here it is the ghost of the material tier D-4 shows is missing: the class exists exactly where a `Surface`/`Card` should be.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static grep, output above.
defects.proposedCure: Delete it, or make it the real seat: if the plate keeps a hand-rolled root at all, that root is where the glass-ui material belongs. D-1/D-4's cure removes the need for the class entirely.

defects.defect: The caught transition is an unmanaged full-slab jump-cut in an application where every other scene change is choreographed. The entire two-pane scene vanishes and the plate appears in the same frame, with no entry, no exit on reset(), and no tokenized curve.
defects.evidence: Every PaneSlot arrives through `transition-name="vj-enter"` plus the `appear` plate-land grammar — App.vue:87, :106, :132; demo/color-picker/composables/boot/overture.css. ErrorBoundary.vue contains no `<Transition>`, no transition class, and no animation token. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §6: 'A scene swap preserves the specimen and changes the surrounding instrument. No full-slab remount hole, rAF-delayed blank, or dock collapse.'
defects.mechanism: F1 — the boundary sits outside the seat that owns the motion grammar, so it neither adopts nor deliberately declines it. Not a prefers-reduced-motion defect (there is no motion to reduce); the absence is the defect. Owner edict 6 is not violated — no animation was deleted, none was ever authored.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static: ErrorBoundary.vue has no transition wrapper; compare App.vue:87/106/132.
defects.proposedCure: Rendering inside PaneSlot (D-1's cure) makes the fallback arrive through the existing `vj-enter` + plate-land grammar automatically, with the PRM collapse already handled by overture.css. No new keyframes.

defects.defect: The component's entire public API is inert at its sole call site: `message` is passed a string byte-identical to its own default, `retryLabel` is never passed, and the `reset` emit is never listened to.
defects.evidence: App.vue:50 `<ErrorBoundary message="This panel hit an unexpected error.">` — no `@reset`, no `:retry-label`. ErrorBoundary.vue:44 declares that identical default; :45 declares `retryLabel = "Try again"`; :53 `defineEmits<{ reset: [] }>()` and :74 `emit("reset")` have no consumer.
defects.mechanism: F2 — speculative API around an affordance that does nothing (D-3). Owner edict 3 (KISS, no contrivance): props exist so copy can vary, and the one consumer passes the default verbatim.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static: the sole usage is App.vue:50; `grep -rn 'ErrorBoundary' demo/` returns only App.vue:50,140,180.
defects.proposedCure: Under D-2's cure the boundary becomes per-pane and these props carry genuine pane-specific copy and a real reset hook. If that cure is declined, delete all three.

defects.defect: State coverage is 2 of roughly 14. Most consequentially, async and unhandled-rejection failures never reach this boundary at all, so the API-bound failures in Browse/Library/Admin — the most likely real failures — are outside its coverage despite its stated job.
defects.evidence: ErrorBoundary.vue:59-69 registers only `onErrorCaptured`, which does not receive floating promise rejections; there is no `window.onunhandledrejection` wire anywhere in demo/. Undesigned states: repeat failure (D-3), error-during-reset, empty detail (`v-if` at :27 is dead — an Error always has a non-empty message), overflowing detail (evidence/EB-probe3.json → zoom200: overflowStyle 'visible', pageCanScroll false at 720x450, so content longer than the band escapes with no scroll), RTL (D-10), forced-colors (no non-colour failure register beyond prose; the glyph is aria-hidden at :23), 200% zoom (D-9), dark (D-4), focused (D-7b).
defects.mechanism: F4 — the surface's stated job was never enumerated against its actual reachable states, so the coverage claim in the header comment exceeds the mechanism by a wide margin.
defects.reproduction: NONE for the async gap (structural: Vue's onErrorCaptured contract). Overflow measured: node .../eb-probe3.mjs zoom200 case reports overflowStyle 'visible', ebScrollH == ebClientH == 338, docScrollH == winH == 450.
defects.proposedCure: Enumerate the reachable failure states and design each one, or narrow the header comment to what the mechanism actually covers. If async failures are meant to be in scope, they belong to a per-entity status region (PROPORTION-AUDIT PR-08), not to a render-time boundary.

defects.defect: The component has zero tracked frames across the tranche's ten visual matrices. Its only pre-existing capture is filed under a different component, where the D-1 defect is plainly visible and went unremarked.
defects.evidence: docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/REPORT.md covers 15 routes x 4 matrices = 60 captures reporting blankOrNearBlank 0 and pageErrors 0; the shots/ directory adds rtl-desktop, rtl-mobile, forced-colors-desktop, reduced-motion-desktop, keyboard-focus-desktop and zoom-200-desktop. defects.defect: The colour specimen is invisible against the surface it is a specimen on. In /atmosphere light mode every one of the six harmony strips renders its terminal stop at 1.011-1.124 : 1 against the pixels 2px to its right; in /generate light the whole Pastel chip sits at 1.011-1.345 : 1; in /generate dark the whole Earth chip sits at 1.159-1.577 : 1. 22 of 24 measured chips carry at least one stop below the 3:1 non-text floor, 7 carry a stop below 1.15:1. The declared cure — the F8 inset hairline ring at --foreground 12% — itself measures 1.228-1.748 : 1 in light. The cure is fainter than the disease.

defects.mechanism: F-alpha — a specimen with no well: opaque stops painted straight onto translucent menu glass, bounded only by a 1px INSET ring that bounds the plate rather than the stops, in a single channel (background-color) with no structural fallback. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §2 assigns palette specimens the 'specimen well — opaque/quiet neutral stage' tier; this one sits on the instrument-veil tier. §4.1: 'a token name is not evidence'.
defects.reproduction: Dev server on :9000. `node probes-D/pixel-capture.mjs && python3 probes-D/pixel-contrast.py` (copies at docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/PreviewStrip/probes-D/). defects.proposedCure: Do not thicken the ring. Give the specimen its own well: the plate becomes an opaque neutral quiet stage (the same surface=opaque / tier=quiet material the canon already mandates for palette entity Cards, VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §3.1) with per-stop 1px neutral gutters, so terminal and adjacent stops stay countable regardless of what is behind the menu. defects.defect: Forced Colors Mode erases the component entirely and leaves a ~50px phantom indent. Every segment is forced to rgb(255,255,255) and the box-shadow ring is suppressed, so the chip becomes a white void on white canvas; the 42px + 8px gap reservation survives, pushing every description line 50px into its own row against nothing. On /atmosphere, where the chip is the row's ONLY content, the six harmony rows collapse to six identical labels with a blank second line.
defects.evidence: Chromium, forcedColors:'active', emulation verified in-page (matchMedia('(forced-colors: active)').matches === true): seg0.bg='rgb(255, 255, 255)', segLast.bg='rgb(255, 255, 255)', boxShadow='none', forcedColorAdjust='auto'. Frame frames-D/D2-forced-colors-vanished.png. Note the shipped visual matrix cannot see this: audit/visual/states.mjs:24 runs the forced-colors arm on WebKit, which does not honour the emulation — my WebKit re-run still reported live oklch() segment backgrounds and a live box-shadow, so that matrix arm is inconclusive.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — the entire payload is background-color, a forced property in Forced Colors Mode; the only boundary is a box-shadow, which is suppressed. forced-color-adjust is never declared (computes 'auto'). PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.7 — 'visual glyph size, operable target size and layout reservation are separate quantities' — the reservation outlives the glyph.

defects.proposedCure: A colour specimen cannot show colour in forced colors; it must show structure. The D-1 well supplies a ButtonBorder-tier frame that survives, and the per-stop gutters become 1px CanvasText rules so the strip still reports how many stops there are. If colour is judged the whole point, the honest alternative is to collapse the reservation under @media (forced-colors: active) rather than reserve 50px for nothing. Either is a decision; 'auto' is not.

defects.defect: The 'one golden plate' law is false at every viewport and drifts 31%. Measured width/height: 2.9911 at 320px and 390px (+14.25% vs phi^2), 2.8450 at 768px, 2.5548 at 1440px (-2.41%), 2.2886 at 2200px (-12.58%). Never 2.6180. Browser zoom compounds it: 200% zoom halves the CSS viewport, so a 1440px window renders the ~2.85 ratio of a 720px column. Compounding this, the literal 2.618rem is hardcoded in two files while two design tokens already carry that exact value.
defects.evidence: probes-D/ratio-sweep-forced-rtl.mjs SWEEP lines (log probes-D/ratio-sweep.log): 8 measurements, zero equal phi^2, spread 2.2886…2.9911. Source: PreviewStrip.vue:59 `inline-size: 2.618rem; /* one golden plate — phi^2 × 1em (F7) */` against `block-size: 1em` at :60; the local font-size is the vw-clamped `--type-caption: clamp(0.75rem, 0.71rem + 0.21vw, 1rem)`. Unused tokens: demo/styles/foundation.css:462 `--phi-4: 2.618rem` and glass-ui `--space-phi-5: 2.618rem` (grep -rn '2\.618' demo/ = 8 hits).
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the primitive was never rooted: inline-size is root-relative (rem) while block-size is locally inherited (em) on a vw-clamped token. Two axes on two scales cannot hold a constant ratio, so the declared relation is unexpressible in the code that declares it. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.8 verbatim: 'Real rendered relation wins over token intent... token presence alone cannot close a row.' Owner edict 5 (root-level styling) is breached twice by the hardcoded literal.
defects.reproduction: `node probes-D/ratio-sweep-forced-rtl.mjs` and read the SWEEP lines; or measure `.preview-strip` getBoundingClientRect() with the Palette harmony menu open at 320px and at 2200px.
defects.proposedCure: One unit system, one token: `block-size: 1em; inline-size: calc(1em * var(--phi-2))`, hoisted to the shared root of D-8 so it is declared once. Then phi^2 is true by construction at every clamp arm and every zoom level. --radius-sm has the same disease in miniature (fixed 4px on a 14→18.3px plate); it must scale with the plate too.

defects.defect: Adjacent stops reach 1.002 : 1, so the 'n hard segments' grammar cannot be counted — a five-colour strip reads as three. There is no separation of any kind between segments.
defects.evidence: Rendered pixels, probes-D/pixel-contrast.py MINadj column: gen-light Pastel 1.004, Neon 1.019, Vibrant 1.033; gen-dark Neon 1.016, Pastel 1.038; computed-style census probes-D/model-contrast.log recorded Vibrant dark at 1.002. /atmosphere 1.308-1.489. Source: PreviewStrip.vue:67-70 — `.preview-strip-segment { flex: 1 1 0; block-size: 100% }`, no border, no gutter, no outline. Frame frames-D/D1-gen-light-pastel-6x.png.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — the stop count, which is the strip's whole semantic payload, is conveyed by colour difference alone with no structural fallback. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4.1: 'Selected, failed, pending, withdrawn and disabled states are never color-only.'
defects.reproduction: `node probes-D/pixel-capture.mjs && python3 probes-D/pixel-contrast.py`, MINadj column. By eye: /#/generate light, open Generation preset, look at the Pastel and Neon rows.
defects.proposedCure: Fold into D-1's well: 1px neutral gutters between stops. The same mechanism also supplies the forced-colors arm of D-2 for free — one move, three findings closed.

defects.defect: The truncation affordance is a 4.5px alpha ramp on a 5.98px sliver, indistinguishable from a genuinely pale terminal stop — and invisible by construction on the Pastel preset, where every stop already measures <=1.345:1 against the row. Counts 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 (five of twelve reachable values) render identically as seven segments, so the chip cannot report which. The component's own stated F5 law — 'the strip a row shows is what selecting it yields' — is therefore false for 5 of 12 reachable counts, with no visual cue telling the reader which regime they are in.
defects.evidence: Count slider domain GenerateControls.vue:300-302 (:min=1 :max=12); cap PreviewStrip.vue:25 STRIP_SEGMENT_CAP=7; mask PreviewStrip.vue:73-74. Measured at count=12 (probes-D/states.mjs): stopCount 12, segCount 7, truncated true, segment width 5.984px each, mask 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0,0,0) 20%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 95%)' → the fade runs 1.20px→5.68px inside a 5.98px sliver. All ten rows [[12,7,true] × 10]. Frame frames-D/D5-count12-truncation-light.png. Docblock claim contradicted: PreviewStrip.vue:5-7.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — an elision STATE conveyed colour-only, at sub-perceptual scale, in the same channel as the data it is meant to be distinguished from. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.6 'Subtraction precedes explanation.' The N-4 note (PreviewStrip.vue:10-16) rejects widening the plate to protect 'the description-lane rhythm' — but /atmosphere already breaks that rhythm by +17.5% (D-6), so the rhythm being protected is not held.
defects.reproduction: /#/generate, drag Color count to 12, open the Generation preset select. Or `node probes-D/states.mjs` (scenario truncate-12).
defects.proposedCure: Either the plate elongates with the palette — a strip is allowed to be as long as its data — or the elision is reported structurally: a hairline tick per elided stop, or a '+5' numeral. Never an alpha ramp that mimics a colour. (The truth-law half of this defect is independently confirmed by the sibling seat at challenge-C-implementation.md §C-1/C-3/C-4.)

defects.defect: On /atmosphere the chip buys a +17.5% row-height tax to occupy 1.49% of a row it leaves ~95% empty, while contributing nothing to the accessibility tree. Harmony rows measure 51.69px; the Arrangement and Medium rows in the same pane measure 44.00px. The chip is the sole content of the SelectItem #description slot and is aria-hidden, so the row's entire accessible text is 'Analogous '.

Pixel probe: rowW 889.86, rowH 51.69, chip 41.875x16.39, chipAreaSharePct 1.49. Accessible text of the first option measured as 'Analogous '. Source: AuroraPane.vue:130-134 (chip alone in #description); PreviewStrip.vue:43 aria-hidden. Frame frames-D/D6-atmosphere-row-acreage.png.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the primitive is used at footnote scale in a composition where it is the protagonist. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §3.2: 'Empty secondary content occupies at most a narrow invitation tray (<=15% of the stage) or disappears.' PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.5: a small mark is data, status, action, drag, focus register — or removed; here it is data whose only channel dies in forced colors and never reaches AT.
defects.reproduction: `node probes-D/rtl-forced-rhythm.mjs` (scenario atmo-rhythm); or open /#/atmosphere and compare the Palette harmony menu row height with Zone arrangement and Painterly medium.
defects.proposedCure: On /atmosphere the chip IS the row's differentiator, so make it the row's protagonist: a leading plate in the name lane at the name's optical weight, items-center, one line, sized against the 890px available rather than 42px. That removes the second line and restores the 44px pane rhythm at the same time.

defects.defect: The truncation mask is a physical 90deg gradient inside a direction-aware flex row, so under RTL the elision cue inverts: the flex order reverses and the masked :last-child lands at the strip's outer left edge, while the mask keeps fading rightward — i.e. inward. The cue reads as a smear punched into the middle of the strip instead of a fade at its logical end.
defects.evidence: Measured direction chain under html[dir=rtl]: reka-ui's SelectContent carries a hard dir='ltr' (DIV dirAttr='ltr' class='relative z-popover overflow-hidden rounded-panel...'), so today the whole popover stays LTR inside an RTL document and the defect is masked by a producer bug. With that one attribute honoured (probes-D/rtl-forced-rhythm.mjs, scenario rtl-forced): direction 'rtl', chip spans x 1161.13…1203.00, segments run x 1197.02 → 1161.11 descending, and seg6 (the outer-left one) still carries mask 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0,0,0) 20%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 95%)'. Source PreviewStrip.vue:73-74. Frame frames-D/D7-rtl-mask-inverted.png.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — a physical direction keyword decorating a logical layout end. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §6.1: 'chrome, navigation and layout — logical inline/block direction follows the document.' Contingent, not latent-forever: it manifests the moment the obvious RTL fix lands on the producer.
defects.reproduction: `node probes-D/rtl-forced-rhythm.mjs` (scenario rtl-forced) — sets documentElement dir=rtl, opens the preset menu at count 12, then flips the popover's dir='ltr' to 'rtl' and re-measures.
defects.proposedCure: `mask-image: linear-gradient(to inline-end, ...)`. Better: adopt D-5's structural elision cue, which has no direction at all.

defects.defect: Design-system boundary breached four ways, all one mechanism. (1) `.preview-chip` is minted twice in two scoped blocks (PreviewStrip.vue:56-65, PreviewRamp.vue:40-49) — because both are scoped the shared name is a fiction, and they have already drifted (inline-flex vs inline-block; the F7/F8 rationale comment exists on one only). (2) A third mint of the same primitive is imported into the same file: GenerateControls.vue:16 PaletteColorStrip + :20 PreviewStrip, both 'n colour bands in a clipped aria-hidden box painted with background-color' — and PaletteColorStrip already carries the 8% segment legibility floor PreviewStrip most needs. (3) glass-ui 7.0.0 already exports ./chip (Chip, chipVariants, ChipProps) and owns the .glass-chip class family; demo/ mints a second, unrelated 'chip' vocabulary. (4) The plate width 2.618rem is hardcoded twice while --phi-4 (demo/styles/foundation.css:462) and --space-phi-5 (glass-ui) both hold that exact value.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:56-65 vs PreviewRamp.vue:40-49 (byte-similar, disjoint scopes). GenerateControls.vue:16,20. PaletteColorStrip.vue:44-72 (WEIGHT_FLOOR = 0.08). `node -e "...package.json exports"` → './chip' present; node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/chip/{types,chipVariants}.d.ts define Chip mode/shape/size/tone/surface and .glass-chip--cell/--icon. `grep -rn '2\.618' demo/` → 8 hits including foundation.css:462.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the primitive was never rooted. Owner edict 3 (KISS, no contrivance), edict 4 (glass-ui is the design system; reuse existing component-type names) and edict 5 (root-level styling, never per-instance) are each breached by the same absence of a shared root.
defects.reproduction: `grep -rn 'preview-chip' demo/` (two scoped definitions); `grep -n 'PaletteColorStrip\|PreviewStrip' demo/workbenches/generate/GenerateControls.vue`; `grep -rn '2\.618' demo/`.
defects.proposedCure: One primitive, rooted in glass-ui: a `swatch-strip` (or a Chip shape='specimen' variant) owning the well, the per-stop gutters, the forced-colors arm, the logical-direction elision cue, and the phi^2 plate in one unit system from one token. PreviewStrip, PreviewRamp and PaletteColorStrip become thin domain adapters over it. That single transposition closes D-1, D-2, D-3, D-4, D-7 and D-13 at once — the tell that it is the correct altitude.

defects.defect: A strip of one is a swatch wearing palette clothes. `v-if="stops.length >= 1"` admits count=1, producing a single 42x16 block still carrying the palette grammar — plate radius, plate ring, and the phi^2 proportion whose whole meaning is 'a sequence'. The sibling PreviewRamp sets its floor at >= 2 precisely because one stop is not a ramp.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:40 `v-if="stops.length >= 1"` vs PreviewRamp.vue:31 `v-if="stops.length >= 2"`. Count slider GenerateControls.vue:300 `:min="1"`.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the two members of a declared one-law family disagree about the floor of that law.
defects.reproduction: /#/generate, drag Color count to 1, open the Generation preset select.
defects.proposedCure: Raise the floor to 2 and let the single-colour case render the app's existing swatch species (WatercolorDot or the glass-ui Chip tone face), which is what one colour actually is.

defects.defect: A disabled option row would dim the colour specimen. SelectItem accepts `disabled` and glass-ui applies data-[disabled]:opacity-disabled to the row, which would composite the stops toward the row ground — a colour specimen at reduced alpha reports colours that are not the colours.
defects.evidence: glass-ui SelectItem props include `disabled: { type: Boolean }` (dist/select-BcBAyLXA.js) and the item class carries `data-[disabled]:opacity-disabled` (measured on the live rows: class '...data-[disabled]:cursor-not-allowed data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-disabled...'). No host renders a disabled preview row today.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — the specimen inherits row-level state styling it should be isolated from, exactly the isolation the canon already mandates for the WatercolorDot face (VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4.2: 'WatercolorDot face delta is 0').
defects.reproduction: NONE — this is a labelled HYPOTHESIS. Trigger: add `disabled` to any preset/harmony SelectItem in GenerateControls.vue or AuroraPane.vue.
defects.proposedCure: The D-1 well opts the specimen out of row-level opacity; disabled is then expressed on the label and the well's frame, never on the colour.

defects.defect: The honest-absence arm is unreachable and therefore unproven. `v-if="stops.length >= 1"` never evaluates false in either host — generatePalette(count>=1,...) always returns >=1 entry and resolveCalibratedAtmosphere(...).palette is never empty — and the O-14 e2e honest-absence leg exercises the RAMP on /mix, not the strip. The strip's absence policy exists only in prose.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:40; useColorGeneration.ts count ref min bound is the slider's :min="1"; aurora-harmony-stops.ts maps a non-empty resolved palette; e2e/smoke/oracles/o14-preview-truth.spec.ts:334-344 asserts `listbox [data-stops] count === 0` on the Mix Color-space menu (the ramp), never on a strip host.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — a declared law with no reachable arm and no gate, so it can neither be relied on nor falsified.
defects.reproduction: NONE — established by enumeration of the two producers plus the e2e route.
defects.proposedCure: Either delete the unreachable guard (the hosts guarantee non-empty) or, if the shared root of D-8 keeps it, give it a reachable producer and an oracle. A law with no arm is dead weight.

defects.defect: The chip of the currently-selected row is pixel-identical to the nine that are not; the specimen declines a selection-register job it is well placed to carry.
defects.evidence: Measured: gen-light Vibrant row data-state='checked' data-highlighted=true, atmo Analogous row aria-selected='true' — in both cases the chip's computed geometry, ring and segment paint are identical to the unchecked rows (probes-D/model-contrast.log, all rows report the same boxShadow/rect/ratio). The only marker is the producer's gutter dot.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — one channel (colour) doing one job. Defensible under PROPORTION-AUDIT §5.14 (exactly one marker), but recorded because the specimen could be that marker.
defects.reproduction: NONE required — open either menu and compare the checked row's chip with any other.
defects.proposedCure: Optional: let the D-1 well carry the selected state on its frame (a nonzero monochrome and forced-colors delta, per VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4.2), so the specimen reads as 'the palette you have' without adding a second marker.

defects.defect: A fixed px radius on an em-scaled plate: --radius-sm resolves to 4px, which is 28.6% of the plate height at 14px and 21.9% at 18.3px, so the corner character is not scale-invariant. At the segment cap the two end segments lose ~7% of their painted area to the corner arcs while interior segments lose none, so the grammar's promised 'equal hard segments' are optically unequal at the ends.
defects.evidence: Measured borderRadius '4px' on .preview-strip at every viewport, against measured heights 14.000 / 14.719 / 16.391 / 18.297 px (probes-D/ratio-sweep.log). Arithmetic: corner area removed = (1 - pi/4) * 4^2 * 2 = 6.87 px^2 of a 5.984 x 16.391 = 98.0 px^2 end segment. Source PreviewStrip.vue:61.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the same mixed-unit mechanism as D-3, expressed in the corner rather than the aspect.
defects.reproduction: Derived arithmetic over the E-1 measurements; visible in frames-D/D1-gen-light-pastel-6x.png where the peach stop's left boundary is a quarter-round.
defects.proposedCure: Scale the radius with the plate (`border-radius: calc(1em * var(--radius-plate-ratio))`) inside the shared root of D-8, so the corner is a proportion rather than a constant.

result.strongestDefect: D-1 — the colour specimen is invisible against the surface it is a specimen on, and the F8 inset ring named as the cure for exactly that failure measures fainter than the failure. Rendered-pixel evidence: every /atmosphere light-mode harmony strip's terminal stop at 1.011-1.124 : 1; the whole /generate Pastel chip at 1.011-1.345 : 1; the ring itself at 1.228-1.748 : 1. 22 of 24 chips carry a stop below the 3:1 non-text floor. A preview component whose entire purpose is truthful colour is, measurably, not showing the colour.
result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, so this is not a negative-proof verdict — but the following were attacked and found SOUND, and are recorded in the report so a later seat does not re-litigate them. (1) MOTION: `grep -nE "transition|animation|@keyframes|will-change|transform" demo/color-session/color-chips/PreviewStrip.vue` returns nothing (exit 1). Nothing animates, so nothing forces layout and prefers-reduced-motion needs no arm; owner edict 6 is not engaged because no animation was ever present or removed (`git log --oneline -- demo/color-session/color-chips/PreviewStrip.vue` = one commit, a61094e3, a tree move). A tokenized cross-fade here would be a regression — a half-faded colour specimen is a lying colour specimen. (2) Vue 3.5 idiom (edict 7): `const { stops } = defineProps<...>()` at :27-30 is correct reactive props destructure; no template ref and no defineModel, so useTemplateRef and the shallowRef caveat do not apply. (3) verbatimModuleSyntax (edict 8): both imports at :21-22 are value imports; no type-only import to mis-declare. (4) God modules (edict 1): 76 lines, one job, one export; the barrel exports four symbols. (5) Legacy/compat (edict 2): no aliases, shims, dual paths or masking fallbacks. (6) The aria-hidden attribute itself is correct on /generate, where the row carries a name and a text description — it is the /atmosphere composition that is wrong (D-6), not the attribute. (7) Row overflow: `flex: none` on the plate plus min-w-0 on the host wrapper truncates the description and never the specimen; measured overflowX = 0 at 320px. Correct priority. (8) Idle cost: the SelectContent unmounts when closed, so the chips cost nothing at rest, and no pageErrors were raised on /generate by any probe.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-system boundary, proportion/seat law)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]`. Spawned with an explicit Opus 5 declaration; served tier agrees. Not inherited, not undeclared.
result.strongestDefect: D-16 — PaneHeader is the THIRD parallel header-condense choreography in this one app, and the only one that steps no layout quantity at all. glass-ui 7.0.0 ships the complete seam (`CardHeader` `shrink` prop + `.card-scroll-host` + `components/card/card-scroll.css`: real `font-size` + `padding-block-start` step, `display:none` description collapse, tokenized `--duration-normal`/`--ease-standard`, its own `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` arm, and `CardTitle as` for the heading level). `demo/picker/composables/useHeaderCondense.ts` is a second, in-repo, discrete two-state implementation already shipping on Picker — whose own docblock (:9-15) explicitly REJECTS the producer for being "compositor-only ... structurally cannot satisfy §0.8/BR-9" and delivers real padding + font-size steps at `demo/picker/header.css:82-102`. PaneHeader then shipped, on the other nine surfaces, a choreography that is compositor-only AND contracts even less than the producer does. The nine main pane surfaces received the worst of three available options; the one route that got the good one (Picker) is the one route that is not a PaneHeader consumer. This subsumes D-4 (0.00px contraction), D-5 (RTL transform-origin), D-7 (MT-F023), D-8 (untokenized ranges) and D-11 (.pane-scroll-fade duplicating .card-scroll-host byte-for-byte), and it makes D-1/D-2 unreachable by deleting the ratio entirely.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. One negative WAS proven, and it is recorded as a self-correction in the report at §0.1: my own earlier draft asserted as measured fact that the producer grammar cited at PaneHeader.vue:171-172 was absent from glass-ui ("zero hits across the entire installed dist"). Re-running that exact grep at verification time returned 4 files; `card-scroll` has 4 hits and `components/card/card-scroll.css` exists in full. The claim was false and D-8 is rewritten to the narrower defect that survives (the ranges are untokenized where producer tokens exist; only the `:157` `ScrollCardHeader` component reference is genuinely unresolvable at 0 hits). Chasing that correction is what surfaced D-16, the largest finding in the report. defects.defect: The condensed type rung is derived by nested browser trigonometry inside a leaf component — `--pane-title-shrink-ratio: calc(tan(atan2(var(--type-heading), var(--type-display-1))))` — and WebKit, the app's primary engine, evaluates it wrong. A type-scale relationship was promoted into a browser math-function implementation detail. CARRIED FROM PASS 1, independently re-verified by this seat.
defects.evidence: demo/shared/ui/PaneHeader.vue:140-142. My own 5-declaration isolated CSS repro (no app, no framework), written before reading pass 1's probe: webkit {a:310.796875px, b:618.03125px, c:311.34375px, d:31717.265625px, e:618px} vs chromium {a:618.016px, b:618.031px, c:311.344px, d:31717.3px, e:618px} where a=tan(atan2(1.618rem,2.618rem)), b=tan(31.71776deg), c=tan(31.71776rad), d=atan2(...)/1deg, e=tan(atan(0.618)). WebKit's `a` lands exactly on `c` — atan2() returns the correct angle (d matches Chromium to 6 figures) and tan() then consumes its numeric value as RADIANS. In-app, /#/gradient, identical viewport and identical computed fs=41.888px: webkit stuck matrix(0.655404) w=303px vs chromium matrix(0.805831) w=372px at the same scroll offset; at 390x844 webkit matrix(1.433843) w=324->465px vs chromium matrix(1) w=324px — on mobile Safari the title GROWS 43% inside a 390px viewport, the exact inverse of the design. `grep -rn atan2 demo/ src/` → PaneHeader.vue:141 is the only site in the repository depending on it.

result.strongestDefect: L-1 — the condensed type rung is derived by nested browser trigonometry (`calc(tan(atan2(var(--type-heading), var(--type-display-1))))`, PaneHeader.vue:140-142) inside a leaf component, and WebKit — the app's primary engine, the entire visual-audit matrix, and color.babb.dev's real traffic — computes it wrong. WebKit's `atan2()` returns the correct angle and `tan()` then consumes its numeric value as radians; I reproduced this independently in a 5-declaration CSS file with no app or framework, digit-for-digit identical to the prior pass (webkit a=310.796875px landing exactly on c=tan(31.71776rad)=311.34375px, while b/d/e are correct). Consequence in the shipped app: at 1440 the two engines paint title boxes 303px vs 372px wide at the same scroll offset from identical tokens and identical computed font-size; at 390px Chromium holds the designed 1.0 no-op while WebKit ENLARGES the title 43% (324→465px) inside a 390px viewport — the exact inverse of the design. This is a library-structure defect, not a browser-bug defect: "one golden rung down from display-1" is a type-scale proposition whose home is the token layer, and glass-ui expresses the identical relationship as a discrete token step with no math function at all. Re-deriving a token relationship inside a leaf's calc() promoted a browser's math-function implementation into a design-system input, which is why two engines now ship two designs. It is a direct consequence of L-2 (wrong home), which is why the single cure retires the component.
result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, so no whole-component negative is claimed — but three sub-axes were examined and cleared, and I record them so the jury can distinguish "examined and sound" from "unexamined". (1) IMPORT EDGES: PaneHeader.vue has ZERO JavaScript/TypeScript imports — the entire <script setup> is a four-line defineProps (:34-38). I read all 224 lines. There is no feature→shell edge, no component→boot edge, no demo→src/ deep reach, no cross-feature reach. There is no import edge to violate. (This is precisely why L-4/L2-3 matter: the component's real cross-boundary coupling is a global CSS class, the one kind of edge no import-graph lint can see.) (2) THE PUBLISHED SURFACE OF @mkbabb/value.js is faithfully proved by the demo: `grep -rho "@mkbabb/value\.js[a-z/.-]*" demo/ | sort | uniq -c` → 25 /color, 10 /css, 6 /math, 5 /easing, 4 /quantize, and 1 apparent bare hit that is inside a code comment (demo/shared/utils.ts:14) — 50 specifiers, all five declared subpaths of the seven in package.json#exports, ZERO bare-root imports, ZERO deep reaches (`grep -rn "value\.js/dist\|value\.js/src\|\.\./\.\./\.\./src/" demo/` → no output). And it is structural rather than disciplinary: vite.config.ts:37-50 GENERATES the self-alias set by reading package.json#exports at config time with anchored regexes, so a demo import that a real consumer could not write cannot resolve. Add a subpath and the alias follows; remove one and every demo import of it breaks immediately. This is the one place in the repository where "forbidden by construction" is literally true, and it is the template I propose for curing L2-1. (3) THREE LOCAL CLAIMS CHECKED AND CLEARED: `z-header` (:11) is a live utility, not an inert class — computed z-index 35, position sticky, top 0px, resolving through glass-ui's --z-header:35 (dist/styles/tokens/scheme-motion.css) bridged as --z-index-header (dist/styles/theme/bridges.css); scoped @keyframes do not leak globally (edict 6) — computed animation-name reads pane-header-veil-19daabcf / pane-title-shrink-19daabcf, SFC-hashed, with global keyframes correctly resident in demo/styles/animations.css; and verbatimModuleSyntax (edict 8) is vacuously satisfied. One further negative worth recording: value.js ships src/css/timeline.ts and the /css subpath exports ScrollTimelineDescriptor / AnimationTimelineValue / TimelineAxis, so it is tempting to call PaneHeader's hand-written scroll-timeline a missed dogfood — it is not. That surface is a parsing/serialising model, not an authoring API, and static CSS is the correct way to declare this timeline. Not a defect. Finally, a methodological note: my first probe pass used path URLs (/about, /mix) against a HASH-routed app and silently served the identical page for every route; I caught it because the per-route counts were identical to the digit, discarded the run, and re-measured with /#/… — every figure in the report is from the corrected run.

All 7 dist/subpaths/*.js import neither (grep count 0 each). du -sh: glass-ui 5.2M + keyframes.js 608K vs dist/subpaths 132K = 44x. glass-ui peerDependencies['@mkbabb/value.js'] = '^4.0.0' ⇒ declared cycle.
defects.mechanism: A demo-only design-system need declared as a library runtime dependency; the library program is structurally glass-ui-free (tsconfig.lib.json) yet the manifest says otherwise.
defects.reproduction: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');console.log(p.dependencies)"; for f in dist/subpaths/*.js; do grep -c '@mkbabb/glass-ui' $f; done   # all 0
defects.proposedCure: Move both to devDependencies. `dependencies` becomes {} — the honest declaration for a package whose seven bundles import nothing. Booked as F-GOV-01 (deps STRIP + pre-publish manifest gate).

defects.defect: tsconfig.demo.json hand-rolls a second declaration of the export surface beside vite.config.ts's GENERATED one, and it has drifted: 3 of its 8 mapped targets do not exist after a full build, and it omits 2 published keys.
defects.evidence: Diff: in tsconfig NOT in exports = ['@mkbabb/value.js','…/parsing','…/units']; in exports NOT in tsconfig = ['…/value','…/css']. File existence: MISSING dist/index.d.ts, dist/subpaths/parsing.d.ts, dist/subpaths/units.d.ts; EXISTS css.d.ts, value.d.ts. vite.config.ts:37-50 states 'GENERATED (not hand-rolled) so the alias set can never drift'. NEGATIVE PROOF that it is inert: evidence/resolution-trace.txt — tsc --traceResolution against the REAL tsconfig.demo.json resolves '@mkbabb/value.js/css' via self-name resolution through the repo's own package.json#exports to /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js/dist/subpaths/css.d.ts (the local build), NOT the installed 4.0.0 self-copy (whose css.d.ts is 10,910 B vs the local 12,490 B).
defects.mechanism: Two authorities for one surface: one generated (cannot drift), one hand-rolled (has drifted). Harmless today only because TypeScript self-name resolution independently does the right thing — i.e. the redundant map is load-bearing for nothing.
defects.reproduction: Write a two-line probe importing '@mkbabb/value.js/css' and '…/color' INSIDE the repo; point a tsconfig at it with "extends":"<repo>/tsconfig.demo.json" and "traceResolution":true; run node_modules/.bin/tsc -p. See evidence/resolution-trace.txt.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the value.js `paths` entries from tsconfig.demo.json entirely. One authority for the export surface: package.json#exports — generated for Vite, self-named for tsc. Same single-ownership principle the vite config already applies, extended to the config that did not.

defects.defect: The e2e oracle asserts on glass-ui private internals — the same boundary that silently swallowed `tag=`.
defects.evidence: e2e/smoke/oracles/o9-shadow-palette.spec.ts:74-78 asserts `.watercolor-ghost-stroke` and `[data-variant="ghost"]`. defects.reproduction: cat node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/watercolor-dot/index.d.ts  # no ghost-stroke, no data-variant; then read o9-shadow-palette.spec.ts:74-78

defects.defect: Vue 3.5 idiom fork between the twins, and `?: T | undefined` cancels exactOptionalPropertyTypes across the whole prop surface.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:72-91 uses legacy withDefaults(defineProps<{message?: string | undefined; …}>(), {…}); its near-twin ErrorBoundary.vue:43-51 uses the 3.5 reactive-props destructure with inline defaults and plain `?: T`. tsconfig.base.json:13 sets "exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true, which `| undefined` re-admits explicit undefined against.
defects.mechanism: Two idioms for one job in two files painting the same plate (edict 7); the union widening silently opts the component out of a repo-wide strictness flag.
defects.reproduction: Read EmptyState.vue:72-91 beside ErrorBoundary.vue:43-51 and tsconfig.base.json:13.
defects.proposedCure: Adopt the destructure form and drop every `| undefined`, matching ErrorBoundary. Folds into the EmptyPlate/ErrorPlate split at no extra cost.

defects.defect: No unit test for the tree's most-shared presentational atom; @vue/test-utils is installed with zero consumers repo-wide.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "@vue/test-utils" test/ e2e/ demo/ src/` → no output, yet it is a devDependency. EmptyState has 12 referencing files, two species, five conditional branches. No file under test/ mounts a Vue component (`grep -rln "mount(" test/` → empty).
defects.mechanism: The only coverage is an e2e oracle running inside the booted app — precisely the context where the N-3 masking fallback does NOT fire. The mount context that would prove the defect is the one no test exercises.
defects.reproduction: grep -rn "@vue/test-utils" test/ e2e/ demo/ src/   # no output
defects.proposedCure: Add a mounted EmptyState test with no boot writer present, asserting the computed colour of .plate-ink and the structure of both branches. That converts pass-1 L-5's blast-radius hypothesis into a gate.
